words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.tr: phrase. 乐队室；管弦乐队排练室
words.ex: The students practice in the orchestra room after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们放学后在乐队室练习。

words.tr: phrase. 不核对身份；不查验身份信息
words.ex: He does not check identities at the door.
words.ex_cn: 他不在门口核对身份。
words.en: To fail to verify the identities of people, often in a security context.

words.ex: The students went to the lecture room at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 学生们早上九点去了教室。
words.en: A room in a school or university where lectures, especially large ones, are delivered.

words.tr: 动词短语 教授南方（语境不明，非标准短语；通常 'teach' 和 'south' 不构成固定搭配）
words.ex: He teaches south students how to speak English.
words.ex_cn: 他教南方学生说英语。
words.en: To instruct or educate students in a southern region or at a southern institution.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: He waits for the bus at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交站等公交车。
words.en: A place on a bus route where buses regularly stop to pick up and drop off passengers.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: Many housewives cook meals for their families every day.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭主妇每天为家人做饭。
words.en: A housewife is a woman who spends her time managing the household, caring for the children, and performing domestic tasks, rather than working for a salary outside the home.

words.ex: He wears a black coat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件黑色外套。
words.en: A garment, typically made of wool or a similar fabric, that is black in colour and designed to be worn over other clothing.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把球踢进了网里。
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: The children play on the grass after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草地上玩耍。
words.en: Grass is a very common plant consisting of large numbers of thin, spiky, green leaves that cover the surface of the ground.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.tr: n. 文件；公文；文献；“document”的复数；
words.ex: He filed all the documents in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有文件都放在抽屉里了。
words.en: Documents are written, drawn, or printed materials that provide information or evidence.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: The outer parts of an object, area, or surface, especially when regarded as facing a particular direction.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: He lost his contacts after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后失去了联系。
words.en: People you know who can help you, especially in your work.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: He enjoys collecting stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢收集邮票。
words.en: The act of gathering items together, especially as a hobby or for study.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机实验室；电脑实验室，用于进行计算机相关教学、实验或研究的专用房间或场所
words.ex: The students use the computer laboratory for their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在计算机实验室做作业。
words.en: A room or building equipped with computers and other electronic devices for educational or research purposes.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.tr: adj. 加热了的；激烈的； v. 加热；“heat”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The heated water bubbled in the pot.
words.ex_cn: 加热过的水在锅里冒泡。
words.en: If a discussion or debate is heated, it involves a lot of strong and often angry feelings.

words.ex: The lake is covered with ice in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面结满了冰。
words.en: Ice is frozen water. It is a solid state of water that occurs when water freezes at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the course outline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程大纲。
words.en: A course outline is a document that summarizes the main points of a course, including the objectives, content, and assessment methods.

words.ex: He works as a programmer because it offers good pay.
words.ex_cn: 他做程序员，因为这份工作报酬优厚。
words.en: Good pay refers to a salary or wage that is considered high or above average, often used to describe jobs or positions that offer financial compensation significantly higher than the norm.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机房；机房（用于放置计算机设备或供人使用计算机的房间）
words.ex: The students go to the computer room every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周一去计算机房。
words.en: A room equipped with computers for use by students or employees.

words.ex: He buys fresh fish at the fish market.
words.ex_cn: 他在鱼市买新鲜的鱼。
words.en: A place where fish and seafood are sold.

words.ex: He enjoys leisure activities on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末喜欢从事休闲活动。
words.en: Leisure activities refer to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.tr: n. 肩膀；肩部；肩膀（shoulder 的复数）；
words.ex: He carried the bag on his shoulders.
words.ex_cn: 他把包扛在肩膀上。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the arm is connected, or the part of a piece of clothing that covers this.

words.ex: They share ideas in class every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天在课堂上分享想法。
words.en: To exchange thoughts, opinions, or creative concepts with others in a group setting.

words.ex: The students relax in the common room after class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们下课后在公共休息室休息。
words.en: A student common room is a room in a school, college, or university where students can relax and spend time together when they are not attending classes.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The farmers work in the fields every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫们每天早上在田里工作。
words.en: People who own or manage a farm.

words.tr: 动名词短语，更换床单和床上用品
words.ex: She is changing bed linen every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周一都换床单被套。
words.en: changing bed linen: The act of replacing sheets and pillowcases on a bed.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.tr: n. 爪子；爪子（claw 的复数）；
words.ex: The cat stretched out its claws.
words.ex_cn: 猫伸出了它的爪子。
words.en: The sharp, curved nails on the feet of some animals, used for catching prey, climbing, or fighting.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.tr: n. 村舍；小屋；小别墅；“cottage”的复数；
words.ex: The tourists stayed in small cottages near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 游客们住在湖边的小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, especially in the country.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: She bought a souvenir at the gift shop.
words.ex_cn: 她在礼品店买了一件纪念品。
words.en: A gift shop is a retail store that sells items that are suitable for giving as presents, such as souvenirs, knickknacks, and other small items.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: She baked three cakes for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对烤了三个蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.

words.ex: The money lender gave him a loan with high interest.
words.ex_cn: 放贷人给了他一笔高利息的贷款。
words.en: A money lender is a person or organization whose business is lending money to people who then pay back the money with interest.

words.ex: He handed in his written work on time.
words.ex_cn: 他按时交上了他的书面作业。
words.en: A written work is any piece of writing that has been created by an individual or group, often intended for publication or sharing with an audience.

words.tr: adj. 没意识到的；不知道的；
words.ex: He was unaware of the rain until he got wet.
words.ex_cn: 他直到被淋湿了才意识到下雨了。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.ex: He used a stop watch to time the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用秒表计时比赛。
words.en: A timepiece used to measure the duration of an event with great accuracy.

words.tr: 名词短语，来自期刊的文章；发表在学术或专业期刊上的论文或报道
words.ex: He reads articles from journals every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周阅读期刊文章。
words.en: Written works published in academic or professional magazines.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: The temple walls have old carvings.
words.ex_cn: 寺庙的墙壁上有古老的雕刻。
words.en: The walls of a temple, often significant for their architectural features, inscriptions, or artwork.

words.ex: He bought a city map to find the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张城市地图来找博物馆。
words.en: A city map is a detailed representation of a city's layout, including streets, landmarks, and other points of interest, designed to help people navigate and explore the city.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.ex: Many countries have beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家有美丽的海滩。
words.en: A country is a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

words.ex: He believes in capitalism and owns a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他相信资本主义，并拥有一家小企业。
words.en: Capitalism is an economic system in which the means of production are privately owned and operated for profit in a competitive market.

words.ex: Good healthcare improves the quality of life.
words.ex_cn: 良好的医疗改善了生活质量。
words.en: The standard of health, comfort, and happiness experienced by an individual or group.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.tr: n. 园艺（学）； v. 从事园艺；“garden”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys gardening in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在后院做园艺。
words.en: The activity of tending and cultivating a garden, especially as a pastime.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the whiteboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师在白板上写字。
words.en: A whiteboard is a shiny white board on which people can write or draw with special pens and then wipe off what they have written.

words.ex: You should have a health check every year.
words.ex_cn: 你应该每年做一次健康检查。
words.en: A health check is a medical examination to test your general state of health.

words.tr: phrase. 讨论小组；研讨团体
words.ex: She joined several online discussion groups to share her ideas.
words.ex_cn: 她加入了几个在线讨论组来分享她的想法。
words.en: A discussion group is a group of people who meet or communicate regularly to discuss a particular topic or range of topics.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: I need to buy a new water heater.
words.ex_cn: 我需要买一个新的热水器。
words.en: A device that heats water for use in homes and businesses.

words.ex: The children play outside in hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在炎热的天气里在外面玩。
words.en: A period of unusually hot weather, especially one that lasts for several days.

words.ex: He wears a blue sweater every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都穿一件蓝色毛衣。
words.en: A knitted garment for the upper body, typically with long sleeves, made from wool or synthetic yarn.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: He wears a dark blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿一件深蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: A dark blue color is a deep shade of blue.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: The children perform dances at the school festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校节日上表演舞蹈。
words.en: To move rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.ex: He talks to strangers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和陌生人说话。
words.en: People whom one does not know or with whom one is not familiar.

words.tr: phrase. 预订计算机使用时间
words.ex: I need to reserve computer time for my project tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我需要为明天的项目预订计算机使用时间。

words.ex: Rats ran across the kitchen floor.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑过了厨房地板。
words.en: Rats are small rodents that are often considered pests.

words.tr:
n. 流体；流质；
adj. 流动的；
words.ex: Water is a common fluid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的流体。
words.en: A fluid is a substance that can flow and change its shape easily, such as a liquid or a gas.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: He works part-time to cover his living expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他做兼职来支付生活开销。
words.en: The costs incurred by a person or family for the necessities of life, such as food, shelter, and clothing.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: The department head speaks to the teachers every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 系主任每周一和老师们谈话。
words.en: A department head is a person who is in charge of a department within an organization or company.

words.ex: The birds fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.tr: phrase. 网络连接；互联网连接
words.ex: The internet connections in this town are slow.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的互联网连接很慢。
words.en: The means by which individuals or devices link to the internet, enabling access to a vast network of information and services.

words.ex: The children noticed patterns in the tiles on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了地板瓷砖上的模式。
words.en: Designs or motifs that are repeated in a predictable sequence.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.ex: They play squash on the squash courts after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在壁球馆打壁球。
words.en: Squash courts are the indoor or outdoor facilities where the game of squash is played. They are typically enclosed by four walls with a small, hard ball used in play.

words.tr: phrase. 行动计划；为实现特定目标而制定的具体步骤方案
words.ex: The school made an action plan to improve student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校制定了一项行动计划来提高学生成绩。
words.en: A detailed proposal for doing or achieving something, especially a set of actions intended to achieve a goal.

words.tr: n. 电话亭；摊位；“booth”的复数；
words.ex: He called his friend from a phone booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个电话亭给朋友打了电话。
words.en: A booth is a small enclosed area where goods are sold or services are provided at a fair or market.

words.ex: My family members eat dinner together every night.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人每天晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Family members are individuals related by blood, marriage, or adoption, who form a household together.

words.ex: The company publishes an annual report every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年发布一份年度报告。
words.en: A document prepared by a company at the end of each year, giving details of its financial performance and activities over the year.

words.ex: He works in the entertainment industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在娱乐行业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy that provides entertainment, including movies, music, television, and live performances.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: The box has enough storage space for toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有足够的存储空间来放玩具。
words.en: The area or capacity available for storing data, files, or other materials in a computer or other device.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: The juniors played basketball after school.
words.ex_cn: 年少者们放学后打篮球。
words.en: Juniors refers to individuals who are younger or of a lower rank or position, often used in educational contexts to denote students in their third year of study or in workplaces to refer to employees with less experience or lower status.

words.ex: The sales had a sudden drop-off last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额急剧下降。
words.en: A drop-off is a decrease in the amount, level, or number of something, or a place where something or someone is left.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.tr: n. 广告（advertisement 的复数形式）
words.ex: He sees many ads on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他在手机上看到很多广告。
words.en: Ads are messages or announcements intended to promote a product, service, or event, typically in a public medium such as television, radio, or the internet.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.tr: phrase. 科学期刊；科学杂志（指发表科学研究成果的定期出版物）
words.ex: He reads scientific journals every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都读科学期刊。
words.en: Publications that contain articles on research and studies in various scientific fields, often peer-reviewed.

words.tr: phrase. 笔记系统；注释体系
words.ex: He uses a note system to remember his tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个笔记系统来记住他的任务。
words.en: A method or set of rules for recording information, often in written form.

words.ex: The clouds are moving slowly across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵正在天空中缓慢移动。
words.en: A visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.tr: phrase. 低风险的投资；指波动小、本金损失概率低的投资产品
words.ex: He put his money in low-risk investments.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱投资于低风险的投资。
words.en: Investments that are considered to have a lower risk of losing money, typically offering lower returns than higher-risk investments.

words.tr: n. 报告；报道；“report”的复数； v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: The students handed in their science reports yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 学生们昨天交上了他们的科学报告。
words.en: Reports are detailed accounts or statements about a particular subject, especially one that is investigated or analyzed. They can also refer to the act of reporting or the process of gathering and presenting information.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.tr: n. 眼镜；玻璃杯；“glass”的复数；
words.ex: He wears glasses to see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴眼镜以便清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Glasses are objects worn in front of the eyes to help people see better. They consist of a pair of lenses set in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr: n. 测试；“test”的复数； v. 考验；
words.ex: The students took math tests last week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们上周参加了数学测试。
words.en: A test is a series of questions, problems, or practical tasks to gauge someone's knowledge, experience, or ability.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: The toy is made of poor quality plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具是用劣质塑料制成的。
words.en: Poor quality refers to something that does not meet the expected standards of excellence or is not of high quality.

words.ex: I need to buy house insurance.
words.ex_cn: 我需要购买房屋保险。
words.en: Insurance that provides compensation for damage or loss to a house and its contents.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: Many people go to cinemas on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在周末去电影院。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: He works as an administration officer in the school office.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校办公室担任行政官员。
words.en: An administration officer is responsible for managing the daily operations and administrative tasks within an organization or department.

words.ex: He organized all his files on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他把电脑上的所有文件都整理好了。
words.en: n. A file is a box or a folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. v. If you file a document, you put it in the correct file. If you file a formal or legal accusation, complaint, or request, you make it officially.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: She put the dirty plates into the dishwasher.
words.ex_cn: 她把脏盘子放进洗碗机里。
words.en: A dishwasher is a machine that washes dirty dishes automatically.

words.ex: The water in the pond is cloudy.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水很浑浊。
words.en: If it is cloudy, there are a lot of clouds in the sky.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.ex: Birds change their migration patterns with the seasons.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类随着季节变化它们的迁徙模式。
words.en: Migration patterns refer to the regular movements of animals or people from one region to another, often in response to seasonal changes.

words.tr:
n. 聚光灯；
v. 使公众注意；
words.ex: The spotlight shone on the singer during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 演唱会上，聚光灯照在歌手身上。
words.en: A spotlight is a powerful light, for example in a theatre, which can be directed so that it lights up a small area. If someone or something is in the spotlight, they are getting a lot of attention from the public and the media.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 学生住宿；专为学生提供的居住场所
words.ex: The student lives in student accommodation near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生住在靠近校园的学生宿舍里。
words.en: Housing provided for students, typically by educational institutions or private landlords, to live in while they are studying.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr: phrase. 周报；每周收益；每周回报
words.ex: He sends his weekly return to his manager every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五向经理发送周报。
words.en: A return journey made within a week, especially in the context of travel or commuting.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.ex: The underside of the table is dirty.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的下侧很脏。
words.en: The underside of something is the part of it which normally faces towards the ground or is not normally seen.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: The doctor checked the blood flow in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他腿里的血流。
words.en: The movement of blood through the vessels of the body that is induced by the pumping action of the heart and serves to distribute nutrients and oxygen to and remove waste products from all parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: Please give me your contact number.
words.ex_cn: 请给我你的联系电话。
words.en: A contact number is a telephone number at which a person or organization can be reached.

words.ex: Young teenagers often like to play video games after school.
words.ex_cn: 年轻青少年放学后常常喜欢玩电子游戏。
words.en: Young teenagers refers to individuals in the early stages of their teenage years, typically between the ages of 13 and 15.

words.tr: n. 照明；灯光； v. “light”的现在分词；
words.ex: The room has good lighting.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间照明很好。
words.en: The arrangement or type of light in a place.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: The storms caused power outages last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚的暴风雨导致了停电。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.ex: We have dinner together in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆正在剥落。
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.ex: Students put their books in the lockers after class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们下课后把书放在寄存柜里。
words.en: Lockers are small compartments, typically in a public place such as a school or gym, where individuals can store their belongings securely.

words.ex: We had coffee together in midmorning.
words.ex_cn: 我们在早晨一起喝了咖啡。
words.en: The middle part of the morning, typically between late morning and noon.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.tr: phrase. 完全阻断；全面封锁
words.ex: The total block stopped the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 整个路障阻断了交通。
words.en: A complete obstruction or stoppage of movement or access.

words.ex: He wears sports shoes to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上穿运动鞋跑步。
words.en: Footwear designed for sports or physical exercise, typically featuring a flexible sole and upper made from breathable materials.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: His superiority in math helped him win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的优越让他赢得了比赛。
words.en: If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.tr: phrase. 花的味道；花香的滋味
words.ex: The flower has a sweet taste.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜味。
words.en: The flavor or scent characteristic of a flower.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The market sells fresh meat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市场每天早上卖新鲜肉类。
words.en: Fresh meat refers to meat that has not been preserved by smoking, curing, or freezing and is therefore considered to be in its natural state. It can also metaphorically refer to someone who is new to a particular activity or environment.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.ex: The books are sorted into different categories.
words.ex_cn: 这些书被分成了不同的类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things, people, or ideas that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.tr: phrase. 进行研究；开展调查
words.ex: Scientists conduct research to learn new things.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行研究以发现新事物。
words.en: To carry out a systematic investigation to discover facts.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.ex: We go to the beach during holidays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去海滩。
words.en: Holidays are days when people do not go to work or school, especially because of a religious or national celebration.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr: n. 出版物（publication 的复数）
words.ex: He reads many scientific publications.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读许多科学出版物。
words.en: Publications refer to the act of making something known to the public, especially by printing it in a book, magazine, or newspaper, or the thing that is published.

words.ex: He answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速接了电话。
words.en: to respond to an incoming telephone call

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: He sent a postcard from Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他从巴黎寄了一张明信片。
words.en: A postcard is a piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically rectangular, intended for writing and mailing without an envelope and at a lower rate than a letter.

words.tr: phrase. 热身；变暖；使活跃起来
words.ex: He warms up before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前热身。
words.en: To prepare for physical exertion or a performance by exercising or practicing gently beforehand.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: The children play by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

words.tr: adj. 充满...的；挤满人的；拥挤的； v. 包装；“pack”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was packed with people.
words.ex_cn: 公交车上挤满了人。
words.en: Filled with a large number of people or things.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 黑色天鹅绒（一种柔软、有光泽的深黑色织物）；也指一种由黑啤酒和苹果酒混合而成的鸡尾酒
words.ex: She wore a black velvet dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条黑色丝绒连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A rich, deep black fabric, often with a soft, plush texture, used for clothing, upholstery, or decoration.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.tr: v. 加入；连结；“join”的现在分词； n. 连接；
words.ex: He is joining the club next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要加入这个俱乐部。
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.ex: He switches on the light when it gets dark.
words.ex_cn: 天黑时，他打开灯。
words.en: To turn on an electrical device by operating a switch.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在五月。
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.ex: He listens to a podcast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听播客。
words.en: A podcast is a digital audio file made available on the internet for downloading to a computer or mobile device, typically available as a series, new installments of which can be received by subscribers automatically.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: The school has strict rules about uniforms.
words.ex_cn: 学校对校服有严格的规定。
words.en: Rules are statements that tell you what is or is not allowed in a particular situation or game, or instructions about how to behave or do something.

words.ex: The waves moved the soft sediment on the sea floor.
words.ex_cn: 海浪移动了海底的软沉积物。
words.en: Soft sediment refers to the accumulation of particles that have settled from suspension in a fluid, typically water, and are not yet compacted into rock.

words.tr: phrase. 普遍兴趣；一般关注
words.ex: He reads magazines for general interest.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读那些出于普遍兴趣的杂志。
words.en: A subject or activity that attracts the attention of the majority of people.

words.tr: phrase. 监督团队；管理团队工作
words.ex: He supervises the teams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天监督这些团队。
words.en: Oversee and guide groups of people.

words.ex: He attends regular conferences to learn new skills.
words.ex_cn: 他参加定期的会议来学习新技能。
words.en: Go to scheduled professional meetings or events on a regular basis.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.ex: He earns 50,000 dollars per year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年赚五万美元。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens, is done, or is valid for each year.

words.ex: Children love playing games after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后玩游戏。
words.en: Games are activities or sports that involve skill, chance, or endurance on the part of two or more persons who play according to a set of rules, usually for their own amusement or for that of spectators.

words.ex: We walked along the coast and saw the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，看到了大海。
words.en: The coast is the land along the edge of the sea or ocean.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里很吵。
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: He sent his job application yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天寄出了求职申请。
words.en: A document or form that you complete and submit when you are applying for a job.

words.ex: He watches television drama every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视剧。
words.en: A television drama is a type of program that tells a story through a series of episodes, often focusing on character development and emotional themes.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: The birds fly south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，鸟儿飞向南方。
words.en: Winter is the season between autumn and spring. In the winter, the weather is usually cold.

words.ex: The heater keeps the room warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个加热器在冬天让房间保持温暖。
words.en: A device used to generate heat for warming a space or water.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr: phrase. 身体变化；物理变化
words.ex: The boy is going through physical changes during puberty.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在青春期经历身体变化。
words.en: Physical changes refer to changes affecting the form of a chemical substance, but not its chemical composition.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.tr: phrase. 新事实；新发现的事实
words.ex: He learned new facts about dinosaurs.
words.ex_cn: 他学到了关于恐龙的新事实。
words.en: Recent or previously unknown information.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.ex: The children run in races every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每周五参加比赛。
words.en: Races can refer to a competition of speed, as in running, or to a group of people united by common history, nationality, or geographic distribution.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.tr: n．照片卡片：一种卡片，上面印有照片，通常用于个人或商业目的，如宣传、纪念、收藏等。
words.ex: She collects photocards of her favorite singers.
words.ex_cn: 她收集她最爱歌手的明星卡片。
words.en: Photocards are small cards that feature photographs, often of celebrities or personal photos, used for collection or as promotional material.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.tr: v. 建筑；建造；“build”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They built a house last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年建了一栋房子。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of 'build', meaning to construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.tr: phrase. 金钱日记；收支记录；个人财务流水账
words.ex: He writes down his money diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上记录他的金钱日记。
words.en: A record or journal where one tracks their financial transactions and spending habits.

words.tr: phrase. 退休住宅；供退休人士居住的房屋
words.ex: They moved to a retire house near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他们搬到了海边的一处退休住宅。
words.en: A retire house is a type of residence designed for people who have retired from their professional lives, offering them a comfortable and peaceful environment to spend their retirement years.

words.ex: He works on an agricultural farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个农场工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He left the unanswered questions on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把那些未回答的问题留在了桌上。
words.en: If a question or problem is unanswered, it has not been answered or solved.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.tr: phrase. 电影俱乐部；影迷社团
words.ex: They join movie clubs to watch films together.
words.ex_cn: 他们加入电影俱乐部一起看电影。
words.en: A group of people who meet regularly to watch and discuss movies.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr: n. 雇员；受雇者；“employee”的复数；
words.ex: The company treats all employees with respect.
words.ex_cn: 公司尊重所有雇员。
words.en: Employees are people who are hired to provide services to a company or another person in exchange for compensation, typically in the form of wages or salary.

words.tr: phrase. 大量深入研究；大量深度研究
words.ex: He did much deep research on ancient languages.
words.ex_cn: 他对古代语言进行了大量深入研究。
words.en: A significant amount of in-depth investigation or study.

words.ex: He is polite to everyone he meets.
words.ex_cn: 他对遇到的每个人都很有礼貌。
words.en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.tr: phrase. 唯一的客人；仅一位来宾
words.ex: He was the only guest at the dinner party.
words.ex_cn: 他是晚宴上唯一的客人。
words.en: A single visitor or attendee.

words.ex: Birds eat seeds from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿吃地上的种子。
words.en: Seeds are small, hard objects produced by plants, from which new plants grow.

words.ex: She picked red roses for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲摘了红玫瑰。
words.en: Roses are a type of flower known for their beauty and fragrance, often used in gardens and as gifts.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了苹果的一半。
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.tr: phrase. 个人客户；个体消费者
words.ex: The shop serves individual customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天为单个顾客服务。
words.en: Customers who purchase goods or services for personal use rather than for business or resale purposes.

words.ex: The red flag waved in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 红旗在风中飘扬。
words.en: A red flag is a warning or indicator of a potential problem or danger.

words.ex: He has a bad lung infection.
words.ex_cn: 他得了严重的肺部感染。
words.en: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

words.ex: The lamps in the room are bright.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的灯很亮。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electrical current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: There is a small information desk near the entrance.
words.ex_cn: 入口附近有一个小型信息台。

words.tr: phrase. 作为一个整体；集体地
words.ex: The children play as a group.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一起玩耍。
words.en: As a group means all together or collectively, rather than individually.

words.ex: He uses a tape recorder to practice English.
words.ex_cn: 他用录音机练习英语。
words.en: A tape recorder is a device used for recording and playing back sound on magnetic tape.

words.ex: The fence is made of hazel.
words.ex_cn: 这个篱笆是用榛木做的。
words.en: Hazel is a small tree or bush that produces nuts, or a light brown color.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: The school held an evening event for parents.
words.ex_cn: 学校为家长举办了一场晚间活动。

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.tr: adj. 自己经营的；个体经营的；非受雇于人的
words.ex: He is self-employed and works from home.
words.ex_cn: 他是自由职业者，在家工作。
words.en: Someone who is self-employed works for themselves rather than for an employer.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: He develops film in the darkroom.
words.ex_cn: 他在暗室里冲洗胶片。
words.en: A darkroom is a room from which normal light is excluded, used especially for developing photographs.

words.tr: n. 教学；授课；教导； v. 教；教导；“teach”的现在分词；
words.ex: Teaching is his favorite part of the job.
words.ex_cn: 教学是他工作中最喜欢的部分。
words.en: The work or profession of a teacher; the act of imparting knowledge or skills.

words.ex: He sees an airplane in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看到天上有一架飞机。
words.en: An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: He paints the fences every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都粉刷篱笆。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. To fence means to fight with swords, as a sport.

words.tr: v. 组织；安排；“organise”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有组织的；有条理的；有安排的；
words.ex: She organised a party for her friends.
words.ex_cn: 她为朋友们组织了一场派对。
words.en: Arranged or structured in a systematic way.

words.ex: He was born in England.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在英格兰。
words.en: England is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It shares land borders with Scotland to the north and Wales to the west; the Irish Sea is to the north west, the Celtic Sea to the south west, while the North Sea to the east and the English Channel to the south separate it from continental Europe.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: He drinks orange juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝橙汁。
words.en: The liquid obtained from or present in fruit or vegetables.

words.tr: phrase. 英国国家图书馆，英国最大的图书馆，位于伦敦，收藏有数百万册图书、手稿和其他资料
words.ex: He borrowed a book from the British Library.
words.ex_cn: 他从大英图书馆借了一本书。
words.en: The British Library is the national library of the United Kingdom and one of the largest libraries in the world. It holds over 170 million items from many countries, in many languages and in many formats, both print and digital: books, manuscripts, journals, newspapers, magazines, sound and music recordings, videos, play-scripts, patents, databases, maps, stamps, prints, drawings.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.ex: The family stayed in wooden cabins near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这家人住在湖边的小木屋里。
words.en: Small, simple houses or rooms, especially those made of wood and located in a rural or wild area.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.tr: phrase. 一次故事会议；讨论故事情节或创作构思的会议
words.ex: The writers held a story conference to plan the movie.
words.ex_cn: 作家们举行了一次故事会议来规划这部电影。
words.en: A meeting where ideas for a story are discussed and developed.

words.ex: The baby is crying for milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在哭着要奶。
words.en: The act of shedding tears, often as an expression of distress, pain, or sorrow.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.tr: phrase. 学校记录；学业成绩档案
words.ex: He checked his school record to see his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了自己的学籍记录来看他的成绩。
words.en: A school record is a collection of documents that detail a student's academic performance, attendance, and other relevant information throughout their time at school.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.ex: The teacher bought a replacement for the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 老师买了一把新椅子来替换坏掉的椅子。
words.en: The act of replacing something or someone, or the thing or person that replaces them.

words.tr: v. 吃；喂；“feed”的现在分词； n. 饲养；给食；
words.ex: The baby is feeding on milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在喝奶。
words.en: The act of giving food to a person or an animal.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.tr: phrase. 最上层架子；（引申义）最高品质的，一流的
words.ex: He put the wine on the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把酒放在最上层架子上。
words.en: Of the highest quality or excellence.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr: n. 印刷；印刷术； v. “print”的现在分词；
words.ex: The printing of books started long ago.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的印刷很久以前就开始了。
words.en: Printing is the process of producing texts and images, typically with ink on paper using a printing press.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.ex: The sun shines on the crystals and makes them sparkle.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在晶体上，使它们闪闪发光。
words.en: Crystals are solid materials whose constituents (such as atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in a highly ordered microscopic structure, forming a crystal lattice that extends in all directions.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.ex: Children learn to socialise at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习进行社交活动。
words.en: To socialise means to participate or to cause someone to participate in social activities; to make someone behave in a way that is acceptable to their society.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.tr: n. 向日葵，葵花( sunflower的名词复数 )
words.ex: The field was filled with sunflowers, their faces turned towards the sun.
words.ex_cn: 田野里满是向日葵，它们的面朝向太阳。
words.en: Tall plants with large yellow flower heads, often grown for their seeds and oil.

words.tr: adj. 负有责任的；应作解释的
words.ex: He is accountable for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他要为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.

words.tr: phrase. 电话采访；电话面试
words.ex: He did phone interviews for his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他为新工作进行了电话面试。
words.en: A phone interview is a type of job interview conducted over the telephone, often used as an initial screening process.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: The host showed great hospitality to the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主人对客人表现出极大的款待。
words.en: Hospitality is friendly and generous behaviour towards guests, especially by giving them food, drink, or a place to stay.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.ex: The factory uses raw materials to make products.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用原材料制造产品。
words.en: Raw materials are basic substances that are used to make products or to create energy. They are often natural resources such as oil, wood, or metal.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: The window glass is clean and clear.
words.ex_cn: 窗玻璃干净又透明。
words.en: Window glass refers to the glass used in windows, which can be clear, frosted, or treated in various ways for insulation, privacy, or decoration.

words.ex: He walks to the railway station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去火车站。
words.en: A railway station is a place where trains stop so that people can get on or off.

words.ex: He eats nuts every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃坚果当早餐。
words.en: If you say that someone is nuts, you mean that they are crazy. Nuts are hard-shelled fruits of some trees.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: Parents care about children's education.
words.ex_cn: 父母关心孩子的教育。
words.en: The process of facilitating learning, or the acquisition of knowledge, skills, values, beliefs, and habits, in children.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.tr: v. 计划；“plan”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 计划了的；根据计划的；
words.ex: He planned a trip to the beach last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周计划了一次去海滩的旅行。
words.en: Something that is planned is arranged or prepared in advance.

words.ex: I wash my hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 我吃饭前洗手。
words.en: To clean something using water and usually soap.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.tr: adj. 闪烁的； v. “flash”的现在分词；
words.ex: The flashing light warned drivers to stop.
words.ex_cn: 闪烁的灯提醒司机停车。
words.en: A flashing light is one that shines brightly for a short time and then stops shining, then shines again, and so on.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.
