words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.ex: He works as a videotape editor for a TV station.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名电视台的录像带编辑。
words.en: A person who edits videotapes, especially for professional broadcasting or film production.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.tr: phrase. 预期持续时间；预计的持续时长
words.ex: The expected duration of the trip is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的预计时长是两周。
words.en: The period of time that is anticipated or predicted to last.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.tr: phrase. 性价比高的；物有所值的
words.ex: This phone is good value for the price.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机物有所值。
words.en: If something is good value, it is of high quality or worth the money that is spent on it.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急联系号码；在紧急情况下可联系的电话号码
words.ex: Write down your emergency contact number.
words.ex_cn: 写下你的紧急联系人电话。
words.en: A phone number that can be used to contact someone in case of an emergency.

words.tr: v. 引起；导致； n. 原因；事业；“cause”的复数；
words.ex: Smoking causes lung problems.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会引起肺部问题。
words.en: The reason why something, especially something bad, happens.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞走了。
words.en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.

words.ex: The producers make movies for the public.
words.ex_cn: 制片人制作电影给公众看。
words.en: Producers are individuals or companies that create goods or provide services, especially in the fields of agriculture, manufacturing, or entertainment.

words.ex: He got a phone call from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他接到了他妈妈的电话。
words.en: A phone call is a conversation that you have with someone by telephone.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The company made big profits this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profits are the money that a business earns after subtracting all its costs and expenses.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.ex: Ocean currents move warm water across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 洋流将暖水输送到海洋各处。
words.en: Ocean currents are the continuous, directed movement of seawater generated by forces acting upon this mean flow, such as breaking waves, wind, the Coriolis effect, cabbeling, and temperature and salinity differences.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The news reported many issues last week.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道了上周的许多事件。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are discussing or arguing about.

words.ex: The high wind broke the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 大风把树枝吹断了。
words.en: A strong current of air moving across the earth's surface.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.tr: phrase. 设计章节 无中文释义
words.ex: The teacher asked students to design chapters for their group project.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们为他们的小组项目设计章节。

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: The gym charges an annual fee of $50.
words.ex_cn: 健身房收取50美元的年费。
words.en: A yearly charge for the use of a service or membership.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.ex: She became a famous person after her first movie.
words.ex_cn: 她在她的第一部电影后成为了名人。
words.en: A famous person is someone who is known by many people because of their achievements, appearance, or participation in public events.

words.tr: phrase. 预算建议；关于如何规划或管理财务支出的指导
words.ex: He gave me budget advice to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我一些预算建议来省钱。
words.en: Guidance or recommendations on managing personal or organizational finances.

words.ex: He was born in January.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一月。
words.en: January is the first month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.tr: 三周（时间单位，表示三个星期）
words.ex: He will finish the project in 3 weeks.
words.ex_cn: 他将在三周内完成这个项目。
words.en: A period of three weeks.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.tr: phrase. 环境破坏；对自然环境造成的损害
words.ex: The factory caused environmental damage.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂造成了环境破坏。
words.en: Environmental damage refers to the harm or destruction caused to the natural environment by human activities, such as pollution, deforestation, and overfishing, which can lead to the loss of biodiversity and adverse effects on ecosystems.

words.tr: v. 旅游；旅行；“travel”的现在分词； n. 旅行；旅游；游历； adj. 旅行的；巡回的；旅行用的；
words.ex: He loves travelling to new countries.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢去新的国家旅游。
words.en: The activity of making journeys; travel.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr: phrase. 学龄儿童；在校学生（复数）
words.ex: The teacher always makes sure the school children are safe on their way to school.
words.ex_cn: 老师总是确保学童在上学的路上是安全的。
words.en: Children who attend school, typically between the ages of 5 and 18.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.ex: He has back problems from sitting too long.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坐太久而有背部问题。
words.en: Issues or conditions affecting the back, often causing pain or discomfort.

words.tr: phrase. 蔬菜农场；市场花园
words.ex: He runs a small market garden near the town.
words.ex_cn: 他在镇附近经营一个小的菜园市场。
words.en: A market garden is a small-scale agricultural operation focused on the production of fruits, vegetables, and flowers as cash crops, often sold directly to consumers and local markets.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.tr: phrase. 不健康的饮食；指营养不均衡、高糖高脂或过度加工的食物摄入模式
words.ex: He eats unhealthy diets every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃不健康的饮食。
words.en: Unhealthy diets refer to eating patterns that are high in calories, sugar, salt, and unhealthy fats, and low in essential nutrients, which can lead to various health problems.

words.tr: phrase. 舞蹈课程；舞蹈培训班
words.ex: He is taking a dance course on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末在上舞蹈课。
words.en: A series of lessons or classes in which students are taught how to dance.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟学习；指通过互联网或数字技术进行的在线教育或远程学习
words.ex: He attends virtual learning classes at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家参加在线学习课程。
words.en: Virtual learning refers to an environment where students study a curriculum taught by a teacher in a different location, using the internet and other digital tools.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的牛。
words.en: Cattle are large domesticated animals that are kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.ex: He feels pain in his lower back after sitting too long.
words.ex_cn: 他坐太久后感到下背部疼痛。
words.en: The part of the back between the ribs and the hips.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr: v. 共享；分享；“share”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are sharing their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在和朋友分享食物。
words.en: The act of allowing others to use or enjoy something that you possess.

words.tr: n. 约定；约定（appointment 的复数）；
words.ex: I have three appointments this afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我今天下午有三个约定。
words.en: Arrangements to meet someone at a particular time, especially as part of one's job.

words.ex: There is a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一个洞。
words.en: A hole is an opening or hollow space in something solid, or a place in the ground that is deeper than the surface around it.

words.tr: n. 祖父母；外祖父母；爷爷奶奶；
words.ex: I visit my grandparents every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都去看望我的祖父母。
words.en: Grandparents are the parents of a person's father or mother.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.tr: n. （车辆等的）停放；停车场所；停车位； v. “park”的现在分词；
words.ex: There is no parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近没有停车的地方。
words.en: Parking refers to the act of stopping a vehicle and leaving it temporarily in a particular place.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr: n. 攀爬；爬升； v. 攀爬；爬升；“climb”的现在分词；
words.ex: Climbing is his favorite outdoor activity.
words.ex_cn: 攀爬是他最喜欢的户外活动。
words.en: Climbing is the activity of climbing up something, especially mountains or rocks, often as a sport or hobby.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: He will explain the experiment to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班解释这个实验。
words.en: To provide a clear, step-by-step description of a scientific procedure, including its purpose, methods, and expected outcomes.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.ex: She bought some flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一些花。
words.en: The seed-bearing part of a plant, consisting of reproductive organs that are typically surrounded by a brightly colored corolla and a green calyx.

words.ex: He loves learning local history in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢了解自己小镇的本地历史。
words.en: Local history refers to the historical study of a particular community, area, or region, often focusing on the people, events, and developments that have shaped its identity over time.

words.ex: He is learning business management at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习工商管理。
words.en: The process of planning, organizing, directing, and controlling the activities of a business or organization to achieve its objectives.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: He lives in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在苏格兰。
words.en: Scotland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom, known for its distinct culture, history, and landscapes.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.ex: The hotel offers free parking for guests.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为客人提供免费停车。
words.en: Parking that does not require payment.

words.ex: The child left footprints in the wet sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在湿沙地上留下了脚印。
words.en: The marks left by a person's or animal's foot on a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 投资计划；投资方案；投资骗局
words.ex: He lost money in bad investment schemes.
words.ex_cn: 他在糟糕的投资计划中亏了钱。
words.en: Investment schemes refer to plans or strategies for investing money in order to make a profit. These can range from stocks and bonds to real estate and other ventures.

words.ex: The school has a party on children's day.
words.ex_cn: 学校在儿童节举行派对。
words.en: A day celebrating children, often marked by special events and activities.

words.tr: n. 笔记；音调；便条；注释；“note”的复数； v. 谈论；留意；
words.ex: I took notes during the science class.
words.ex_cn: 我在科学课上做了笔记。
words.en: Notes are pieces of information that you write down so that you can remember them later, or short pieces of writing that give you information about a particular subject.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.ex: The children go to the culture centre to learn dance.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们去文化中心学习舞蹈。
words.en: A facility or venue dedicated to the promotion and display of artistic, cultural, or community activities.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的设施；优质的设备或服务条件
words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Adequate or satisfactory equipment or services for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He lives in Bristol.
words.ex_cn: 他住在布里斯托尔。
words.en: Bristol is a city in the southwest of England, known for its historic harbor and vibrant cultural scene.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: The children play in the public areas after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公共区域玩耍。
words.en: Places that are open and accessible to all people, such as parks, streets, and public buildings.

words.tr:
adj. 漫长而艰难的；
adv. 朝上坡方向；
words.ex: Losing weight is an uphill task for many people.
words.ex_cn: 对许多人来说，减肥是一项漫长而艰难的任务。
words.en: If something is uphill, it is going up a slope or hill. If you say that something is uphill, you mean that it is difficult and requires effort.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.ex: The water pipes leak in winter.
words.ex_cn: 水管在冬天会漏水。
words.en: Water pipes are tubes or pipes that carry water from one place to another, especially as part of a water supply system.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 进球的开局；取得进球的开场
words.ex: The team scored opening goal in the first minute.
words.ex_cn: 球队在第一分钟就打进了进球的开局。

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The factory has many machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂里有许多机器。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.ex: He wears a black shirt every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期一都穿一件黑色衬衫。
words.en: A black shirt is a piece of clothing, typically made of cotton or a similar fabric, that covers the upper part of the body and is black in color.

words.tr: phrase. 运送回家；将某人或某物送回家中
words.ex: The bus will transport home the children after school.
words.ex_cn: 公交车会在放学后把孩子们运送回家。
words.en: The act of traveling to one's residence, typically by vehicle.

words.ex: He found some gold coins in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一些金币。
words.en: Coins made of gold, used as a medium of exchange or as a store of value.

words.tr: n. 笔记本电脑；“laptop”的复数；
words.ex: Students use laptops to take notes in class.
words.ex_cn: 学生用笔记本电脑在课堂上做笔记。
words.en: A laptop is a small, portable computer that you can use on your lap.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天中午吃午餐。
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr: 名词短语。大学研究；学院研究，指在高等教育机构中进行的学术性探究或调查活动
words.ex: He does college research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做关于气候变化的大学研究。
words.en: Systematic investigation conducted by students or scholars at a university or college, often involving original data collection and analysis.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.tr: phrase. 更昂贵的；代价更高的；更费钱的
words.ex: Electric cars are more costly than gasoline cars.
words.ex_cn: 电动车比汽油车更贵。
words.en: More costly means requiring more money or resources than something else.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；
v. 邮寄；
words.ex: I checked my mail this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上查了邮件。
words.en: Mail refers to letters, packages, etc., that are sent or delivered by post.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr: phrase. 问题与需求；困难与需要
words.ex: The teacher knows the students' problems and needs.
words.ex_cn: 老师了解学生的困难和需求。
words.en: Issues and requirements that need addressing.

words.ex: The doctor gave me antibiotics for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗生素来治疗感染。
words.en: Antibiotics are medicines that are used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.tr: phrase. 文化意识；对不同文化的价值观、信仰、习俗和行为方式的理解和认识
words.ex: He shows cultural awareness when he respects different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 当他尊重不同的传统时，他展现了文化意识。
words.en: Cultural awareness refers to the understanding and sensitivity towards the differences and similarities between cultures.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.tr: phrase. 音乐磁带；录音带形式的音乐
words.ex: He listens to music tapes on his old player.
words.ex_cn: 他用旧播放器听音乐磁带。
words.en: Recordings of music stored on magnetic tape, typically in a cassette format.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: He chose self employment to work for himself.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了自主就业来为自己工作。
words.en: The state of working for oneself as a freelance or the owner of a business rather than for an employer.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: The fishing industry provides food for many coastal towns.
words.ex_cn: 渔业为许多沿海城镇提供食物。
words.en: The sector of the economy involved in the catching, processing, and selling of fish and other seafood.

words.ex: They did a collaborative project in class.
words.ex_cn: 他们在课堂上做了一个合作项目。
words.en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.tr: phrase. 回收中心；废物回收处理厂
words.ex: He takes bottles to the recycling centre.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子带到回收中心。
words.en: A recycling centre is a place where waste materials are brought to be processed and turned into new products.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我睡觉前读了一本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.tr: n. 照相机；摄像机；“camera”的复数；
words.ex: The children took cameras to the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们带了照相机去公园。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.tr: phrase. 特定疾病；具体病症
words.ex: He is researching a particular disease.
words.ex_cn: 他正在研究一种特定的疾病。
words.en: A specific illness or medical condition, often with distinct symptoms or causes.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: Young children love to play with colorful toys.
words.ex_cn: 小孩子喜欢玩色彩鲜艳的玩具。
words.en: Young children refer to children who are in the early stages of their life, typically between the ages of one and eight years.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.tr: phrase. 连续巡回；连续参观；持续进行的旅行活动
words.ex: The band went on a running tour across five cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队进行了一个连续巡回，覆盖了五个城市。
words.en: A guided tour where participants run through a city or area, often to see sights or landmarks, while also exercising.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期二有一个会议。
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.tr: phrase. 中间阶段；过渡阶段；中期
words.ex: The project is in an intermediate stage.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目处于中间阶段。
words.en: An intermediate stage is a point or period in a process or development that is between the beginning and the end.

words.tr: n. 叶；叶片；“leaf”的复数； v. 留下；离开；离去；
words.ex: The tree loses its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: Leaves are the main organs of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants, usually green and flat, attached to the stems or branches. As a verb, it is the third person singular present tense of 'leave', meaning to go away from a place.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民用河里的水灌溉他们的田地。
words.en: To supply land or crops with water by means of channels or pipes.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: He paid for telephone rental last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月支付了电话租赁费。
words.en: The service of renting telephones to users, typically for a short period of time.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: A land bridge connected Asia and North America long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，一块陆桥连接了亚洲和北美洲。
words.en: A land bridge is a connection between two landmasses, especially a prehistoric one that allowed animals and people to move from one continent to another.

words.ex: They went to the opera house last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去了歌剧院。
words.en: An opera house is a theatre building used for performances of opera.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: He watches satellite tv every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看卫星电视。
words.en: Television broadcasts received via signals from artificial satellites.

words.tr: v. 再投资；“reinvest”的过去分词
words.ex: He reinvested his profit into a new business.
words.ex_cn: 他把利润再投资到一家新企业中。
words.en: To invest again, especially to put (earnings or profits) back into a business or enterprise.

words.tr: phrase. 把它组装起来；把它拼凑起来；把（信息、想法等）整合起来
words.ex: I can't quite put it together, can you explain it again?
words.ex_cn: 我不太明白，你能再解释一下吗？
words.en: To combine or assemble the parts of something.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: A common spider lives in the corner of the room.
words.ex_cn: 一只常见的蜘蛛住在房间的角落里。
words.en: A common spider refers to any of the numerous species of spiders that are frequently encountered in various environments around the world.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: He gave me his e-mail address.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我他的电子邮件地址。
words.en: A unique identifier for receiving electronic mail.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.tr: phrase. 实际成果；实践结果；可落地的成效
words.ex: The project had practical outcomes for daily life.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目对日常生活产生了实际成果。
words.en: The tangible results or effects that arise from practical actions or experiments.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: The boiler heats water for the house.
words.ex_cn: 锅炉为房子加热水。
words.en: A boiler is a device that heats water or produces steam.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.tr: phrase. 胃和心脏（两个身体器官的组合表述）
words.ex: He felt pain in his stomach and heart after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多后，胃和心脏都感到疼痛。
words.en: Referring to the digestive and cardiovascular systems, often in a medical or health context.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.tr: phrase. 触摸桌；一种支持多点触控操作的交互式桌面设备
words.ex: He put his hand on the touch table.
words.ex_cn: 他把手放在触控桌上。
words.en: A touch table is a type of interactive display that allows users to interact with digital content through touch gestures. It is commonly used in educational, business, and entertainment settings.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: He bought some frozen food from the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 他从超市买了些速冻食品。
words.en: Frozen food refers to food that has been subjected to rapid freezing and is kept frozen until use, preserving it from the time of preparation to the time of consumption.

words.tr: phrase. 水处理；废水排放；水的处置
words.ex: The town needs better water disposal to keep the river clean.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇需要更好的废水处理系统来保持河流清洁。
words.en: The process of removing or getting rid of water, especially wastewater, in a way that is safe for the environment.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: He filled out the booking form for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他填写了酒店的预订表格。
words.en: A document used to reserve or book a service, such as a hotel room or flight.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.tr: n. 检查员；巡视员；视察员；
words.ex: The inspector checked the building for safety.
words.ex_cn: 检查员检查了建筑物的安全性。
words.en: An inspector is a person whose job is to inspect something.

words.tr:
n. 英语；英文；
adj. 英格兰的；英格兰人的；英语的；
words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天说英语。
words.en: English refers to the language spoken in Britain, the United States, and many other parts of the world, as well as to the people of England.

words.ex: They had a group discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们就作业进行了一次小组讨论。
words.en: A group discussion is a conversation among a group of people on a specific topic, where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: This store sells the cheapest apples in town.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖城里最便宜的苹果。
words.en: The least expensive option available.

words.tr: phrase. 热巧克力；巧克力热饮
words.ex: He drinks hot chocolate every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上喝热巧克力。
words.en: A hot beverage made from chocolate or cocoa powder, sugar, and milk or water, typically served warm.

words.ex: He works in a lab studying microbiology.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里研究微生物学。
words.en: Microbiology is the branch of biology that deals with microorganisms and their effects on other living organisms.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

words.ex: He is preparing for the mid-term test this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在为期中考试做准备。
words.en: A test or examination taken in the middle of an academic term.

words.ex: My phone rang with an incoming call.
words.ex_cn: 我的电话响了，是一个来电。
words.en: A telephone call that is being received.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.ex: The students are reading books in the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在图书馆里读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university, college, or school.

words.ex: She held a sunshade to block the bright sun.
words.ex_cn: 她撑着一把遮阳伞来挡住刺眼的阳光。
words.en: A sunshade is an object or device that provides protection from the sun's rays, typically consisting of a fabric canopy supported by a frame.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.ex: The cows graze on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Grassland is a large open area of country covered with grass, especially one used for grazing.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.ex: He made a clear argument in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中提出了一个清晰的论点。
words.en: A clear argument is a well-structured and easily understandable point or set of reasons given in support of an idea, action, or theory.

words.ex: We went to two concerts last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了两场音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: The speaker told a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 说话者讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A speaker is someone who speaks, especially someone who gives a speech or makes a presentation.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: The volcanic dust covered the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 火山尘覆盖了附近的城镇。
words.en: Fine particles of rock and mineral ejected by a volcano during an eruption.

words.tr: phrase. 计量单位；测量单位
words.ex: We use units of measurement to find length and weight.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用测量单位来确定长度和重量。
words.en: Units of measurement are standard quantities used to express and compare physical quantities.

words.ex: The boy rides a horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上骑马。
words.en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.ex: They visited three countries and saw many beautiful destinations.
words.ex_cn: 他们访问了三个国家，看到了许多美丽的景点。
words.en: A destination is the place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr: phrase. 意大利菜；意大利食品
words.ex: We eat italian food on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末吃意大利食物。
words.en: Food originating from Italy, characterized by its use of fresh ingredients, olive oil, and a variety of flavors.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.tr: adj. 激励人的；有刺激性的；振奋人的； v. “stimulate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a stimulating talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们做了一场激励人的演讲。
words.en: Making you feel enthusiastic and full of ideas.

words.ex: Many people travel during national holidays.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在国庆假期旅行。
words.en: National holidays are public holidays that are recognized and celebrated across a country, often marking significant historical, cultural, or religious events.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.tr: phrase. 太宽的；过于宽阔的
words.ex: The door is too wide for the frame.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门对门框来说太宽了。
words.en: adj. Exceeding the normal or desired width.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: He eats chocolates every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃巧克力。
words.en: Chocolates are sweet foods made from cocoa beans, often eaten as a treat or given as a gift.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr:
adj. 中国的；
n. 中国人；汉语；
words.ex: She ate Chinese food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭吃了中国菜。
words.en: Of or relating to China, its people, or their languages.

words.tr: phrase. 商业课程；商务课程
words.ex: He is taking a business course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期正在上一门商业课程。
words.en: A course of study that focuses on the principles and practices of business and commerce.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.ex: He reads newspapers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: Newspapers are publications printed on paper and issued regularly, containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information.

words.ex: The cars are parked near the house.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在房子附近。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine and designed to carry a small number of passengers.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: The monkeys are climbing the trees.
words.ex_cn: 猴子们正在爬树。
words.en: Monkeys are mammals of the order Primates, which includes lemurs, lorises, tarsiers, and apes, including humans. They are known for their intelligence and social behavior.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: She combs her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上梳头发。
words.en: Hair is the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals, or the mass of such strands growing from the skin of a person's head.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: She buys new brushes for her painting.
words.ex_cn: 她为绘画买了新刷子。
words.en: Brushes are tools with bristles, wire, or other filaments, used for cleaning, grooming, painting, or other purposes. As a verb, it means to clean, smooth, or apply something with a brush.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: The fisherman mended his nets by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在海边修补他的网。
words.en: Nets are devices made from threads or ropes that are woven together, used for catching fish or other animals, or for various other purposes such as in sports or to protect against insects.

words.ex: Do not share your personal information online.
words.ex_cn: 不要在网上分享你的个人信息。
words.en: Information about a particular person, such as their name, address, and phone number, that can be used to identify or contact them.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.ex: The children in the poor area walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫困地区的孩子们步行上学。
words.en: A poor area is a region where the standard of living is low, and the inhabitants often lack access to basic needs such as food, clean water, and shelter.

words.ex: He majors in history and economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修历史与经济学。
words.en: The study of past events (history) combined with the production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services (economics).

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.ex: The mineral soil helps plants grow strong.
words.ex_cn: 矿物质土壤帮助植物茁壮成长。
words.en: Soil that contains a significant amount of mineral matter, as opposed to organic soil which is primarily composed of organic material.

words.ex: The class is for beginners who want to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 这个课程是给想学英语的初学者的。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and cannot do it very well yet.

words.tr: adj.进口的（动词import的过去分词）
words.ex: The store sold imported apples from China.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售从中国进口的苹果。
words.en: Brought in from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: The farmer works on the farmland field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上都在农田里劳作。
words.en: A piece of land used for growing crops or raising livestock.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.tr: phrase. 体能测试；评估个人身体素质和健康状况的测试过程
words.ex: The students did fitness testing last week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们上周进行了体能测试。
words.en: The process of evaluating the physical condition and capabilities of an individual through various exercises and measurements.

words.ex: The project background explains why we started this work.
words.ex_cn: 项目背景解释了我们为什么开始这项工作。
words.en: The project background refers to the context and circumstances that led to the initiation of a project, including the problem it aims to solve, the objectives it seeks to achieve, and the environment in which it operates.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The city built a road map for new buses.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市为新公交车绘制了一张道路图。
words.en: A road map is a plan or strategy intended to achieve a particular goal.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.tr:
adj. 缓慢的；迟钝的；
v. 使减速；
words.ex: The slow car moved across the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 那辆缓慢的车驶过桥。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving only at a low speed; not fast.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.tr: phrase. 南山（通常指位于美国宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡南部的一片丘陵地区，亦可泛指南方的山丘地带）
words.ex: He lives in south hills with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在南丘。
words.en: The term 'south hills' refers to hills located in the southern part of a region or area, often known for their natural beauty and recreational opportunities.

words.ex: I will meet teacher after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后去见老师。

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.tr: n. 椅子；“chair”的复数； v. 主持；
words.ex: The students sat on the chairs in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐在教室的椅子上。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: He works for an international company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家国际公司工作。
words.en: International means involving or relating to more than one country.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 脚趾；脚趾( toe的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He painted his toes red.
words.ex_cn: 他把脚趾涂成了红色。
words.en: The digits at the end of the foot in humans and other primates.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: He washed his hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 他在吃饭前洗手了。
words.en: The word 'hands' refers to the parts of the body at the end of the arms that are used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things. It can also mean help or assistance, skill in doing something, or the pointers on a clock.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.ex: The moon shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 月亮在夜空中明亮地照耀。
words.en: The natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户是玻璃做的。
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.tr: n. 卡路里（热量单位）；“calorie”的复数；
words.ex: This apple has about 95 calories.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果大约有95卡路里。
words.en: A calorie is a unit of energy. In nutrition, calories refer to the energy people get from the food and drink they consume, and the energy they use in physical activity.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.ex: He improved his study skills to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他提高了学习技巧以通过考试。
words.en: Study skills are strategies and approaches applied to learning. They are generally critical to success in school, considered essential for acquiring good grades, and useful for learning throughout one's life.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.ex: There are 31 women in the meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 会议室里有31名女性。
words.en: Women are adult human females.

words.ex: The children played with colorful balloons at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上玩彩色气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: The trader sells fruits every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人每天早上卖水果。
words.en: A trader is a person who buys and sells goods, currencies, or shares.

words.tr: phrase. 非正常社交时间；指在大多数人休息或社交活动之外的工作时段（如深夜、清晨或周末）
words.ex: He works unsocial hours every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都上夜班。
words.en: Unsocial hours refer to hours outside the standard working day, such as nights, weekends, or holidays, when most people are not working and are engaging in social or leisure activities.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.ex: The company has a simple logo on its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的产品上有一个简单的标志。
words.en: A logo is a design or symbol used by a company to identify its products, services, or itself.

words.ex: I drink coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早晨喝咖啡。
words.en: The morning is the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and the time they start work or school, or the part of the day before noon.

words.tr: phrase. 音效；音响效果（常用于电影、广播或游戏中模拟真实或虚构的声音）
words.ex: The movie has loud sound effects.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有响亮的音效。
words.en: Sound effects are artificially created or enhanced sounds, or sound processes used to emphasize artistic or other content of films, television shows, live performance, animation, video games, music, or other media.

words.tr: phrase. 更好的质量；更优的品质
words.ex: This shirt is better quality than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件质量更好。
words.en: Superior standard or grade of something.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: The children played with plastic pieces in the sandbox.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙箱里玩塑料碎片。
words.en: Small fragments or parts made of plastic material.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.ex: He took a painkiller for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A painkiller is a drug that reduces or removes physical pain.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.tr: n. 街区；积木；砖；块；大楼；大厦；障碍物；“block”的复数； v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: He lives in the next blocks near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园旁边的街区。
words.en: Blocks can refer to solid pieces of material with flat surfaces, or to the act of preventing something from happening or moving.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.tr: n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；捕获物；“prize”的复数；
words.ex: He won three prizes for his science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因科学项目赢得了三个奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: He parked his car on the driveway.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车道上。
words.en: A driveway is a private road that leads from a public road to a house or other building.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 水费账单；用水费用单据
words.ex: He paid the water bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了水费。
words.en: A water bill is a statement of charges for water usage that is sent to a customer by a water utility company.

words.ex: We enjoy live music at the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们喜欢在周末去公园听现场音乐。
words.en: Music that is performed in front of an audience, as opposed to music that is recorded and listened to at home.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: He is good at note-taking in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上很擅长做笔记。
words.en: The practice of recording information from another source, such as a lecture or a book, for future reference.

words.ex: He lives in a student house near the university.
words.ex_cn: 他住在大学附近的学生宿舍里。

words.tr: adj. 受保护的； v. 保护；“protect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The protected forest is home to many rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个受保护的森林是许多稀有动物的家园。
words.en: If something is protected, it is kept safe from harm or damage.

words.ex: The teachers help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 教师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person who teaches, especially in a school.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: Many people live in urban areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多人住在城市地区。
words.en: An urban area is a geographical area characterized by higher population density and vast human features in comparison to areas surrounding it. Urban areas are created through urbanization and are categorized by urban morphology as cities, towns, conurbations or suburbs.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.ex: He teaches math in a secondary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所中学教数学。
words.en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 18.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.tr: phrase. 变得更健康；变得更强健；改善体能
words.ex: He runs every day to get fitter.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以变得更健康。
words.en: To become more healthy and physically active.

words.ex: The fire left ash on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 火在地面上留下了灰烬。
words.en: the powdery residue left after the burning of a substance

words.ex: The accountants checked the company's money records.
words.ex_cn: 会计师检查了公司的财务记录。
words.en: Accountants are professionals who manage financial records, ensure accuracy in financial statements, and help with tax preparation.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.ex: He receives his wages every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: Wages are the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for work that is done manually or in a factory.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: phrase. 野外工作；实地考察
words.ex: The biologists did field work in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 生物学家在雨林中进行了野外工作。
words.en: Field work refers to practical work conducted by a researcher in the natural environment, rather than in a laboratory or office.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊邮件；特快专递或具有特定服务性质的邮件
words.ex: He sent the letter by special mail.
words.ex_cn: 他通过特快邮件寄出了这封信。
