words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 大火车抢劫案；指1963年发生在英国的一起著名火车抢劫事件
words.ex: The great train robbery happened in 1963.
words.ex_cn: 大火车抢劫案发生在1963年。
words.en: A famous 1963 British crime involving the theft of a large sum of money from a train.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: The workers are climbing the scaffold to paint the building.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在爬脚手架去粉刷大楼。
words.en: A scaffold is a temporary structure erected to support workers and materials during the construction, repair, or cleaning of a building or other large structure. It can also refer to a raised wooden platform used formerly for the public execution of criminals.

words.ex: He is a senior adviser to the president.
words.ex_cn: 他是总统的高级顾问。
words.en: A senior adviser is a person who gives advice to the leaders of an organization or government.

words.ex: The picture is in the top right corner.
words.ex_cn: 这张图片在右上角。
words.en: The position at the upper right side of something.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.tr: phrase. 顶尖运动员；顶级运动选手
words.ex: Top athletes train every day to win medals.
words.ex_cn: 顶尖运动员每天训练以赢得奖牌。
words.en: Top athletes are individuals who have reached the highest level of performance in their respective sports, often recognized for their exceptional skills, dedication, and achievements in competitions.

words.tr: phrase. 巨大的增长；大幅度的增加
words.ex: There was a huge increase in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅增加。
words.en: An extremely large rise in the amount, number, or size of something.

words.ex: The city has too much air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有太多的空气污染。
words.en: Air pollution refers to the presence of substances in the atmosphere that are harmful to the health of humans and other living beings, or cause damage to the climate or to materials.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor of computing last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了计算机学士学位。
words.en: A Bachelor of Computing is an undergraduate academic degree awarded for completing a program of study in the field of computing, which includes computer science, information technology, and software engineering.

words.ex: The cows eat grasses in the field.
words.ex_cn: 牛在田野里吃草。
words.en: Plants with narrow leaves growing from the base, covering the ground in many areas.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: He has teaching experience in primary schools.
words.ex_cn: 他有在小学教学的经验。
words.en: The knowledge or skill acquired by a teacher through the practice of teaching over a period of time.

words.ex: Water evaporation happens when the sun heats the lake.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳加热湖泊时，水就会蒸发。
words.en: Evaporation is the process by which a liquid turns into a gas.

words.ex: The self-locking door stays closed without a key.
words.ex_cn: 自锁门不用钥匙也能保持关闭。
words.en: A self-locking device or mechanism is one that locks automatically and cannot be opened without a specific action or key.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr: phrase. 小任务；琐碎的工作
words.ex: He finishes small tasks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上完成小任务。
words.en: Small tasks refer to minor or less significant jobs or assignments that need to be done.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr: phrase. 学习障碍；学习困难
words.ex: Some children have a learning difficulty and need extra help in school.
words.ex_cn: 一些孩子有学习困难，需要在学校得到额外帮助。
words.en: A learning difficulty is a condition that makes it harder for someone to learn in the same way as most other people.

words.tr: n. [劳经]岗位；[测]标杆；邮件（post 的复数）；
words.ex: The company has many open posts for new workers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有许多新的岗位空缺。
words.en: 1. A post is a long, sturdy piece of timber or metal set upright in the ground and used as a support or marker. 2. To post means to display a notice in a public place or to send a letter or package through the postal system.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.ex: He counted the coins with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 他用手指数硬币。
words.en: Fingers are the long thin parts on the end of your hand that you use to hold things.

words.ex: The swans are swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 天鹅正在湖里游泳。
words.en: Swans are large aquatic birds closely related to geese and ducks. They are known for their grace, both in water and in flight.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.ex: He wears a new shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件新衬衫去上学。
words.en: A recently made or acquired shirt.

words.tr: adj. 错误的；不正确的；不当的；
words.ex: The answer is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是错误的。
words.en: If you say there is something wrong, you mean there is something unsatisfactory about the situation, person, or thing you are talking about.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: Fish swim among the seagrass near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海草间游动。
words.en: Seagrass refers to any of various submerged marine plants with long, narrow leaves that grow in dense groups in shallow coastal waters.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: The car stopped at the traffic light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红绿灯前停了下来。
words.en: A traffic light is a set of automatically operated coloured lights, typically red, amber, and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

words.tr: n. 色拉；凉拌生菜；“salad”的复数
words.ex: She eats salads every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她每天午餐都吃沙拉。
words.en: A mixture of raw vegetables, typically served as a dish, either alone or combined with other foods.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.ex: The landlady gives us the keys every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 女房东每周一给我们钥匙。
words.en: A woman who rents out land, a building, or accommodation.

words.tr: phrase. 银质底座；银制镶嵌托架（常用于珠宝或装饰品）
words.ex: The ring has a silver setting.
words.ex_cn: 这枚戒指有一个银质戒托。
words.en: A setting made of silver, often for jewelry or decorative items.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: The schools are open every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 这些学校每个工作日都开放。
words.en: A school is an institution designed for the teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: He bought new maps for his road trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的公路旅行买了新地图。
words.en: A map is a representation of an area of land or sea showing physical features, cities, roads, etc.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母帮我做作业。
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.tr: phrase. 无限里程（指租车或车辆使用中无行驶距离限制）
words.ex: This rental car includes unlimited mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆租赁车包含无限里程。
words.en: A service or feature in car rentals that allows the renter to drive the vehicle without any limit on the number of miles or kilometers traveled, without incurring extra charges.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.tr: phrase. 地址卡；名片；用于记录联系信息的卡片
words.ex: He handed me his address card.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我他的地址卡片。
words.en: A small card bearing a person's name and professional details, used in business contexts.

words.ex: He plays musical instruments every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上演奏乐器。
words.en: Musical instruments are devices created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝茶。
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: She works at the front desk of the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 她在酒店的前台工作。
words.en: The front desk is the place in a hotel, office building, or other establishment where visitors are greeted and dealt with.

words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.ex: The study uses a new methodology to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用了一种新的方法论来收集数据。
words.en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr: phrase. 市场交易额；市场份额；市场占有率
words.ex: The company increased its market share by lowering prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过降价增加了市场交易额。
words.en: The proportion of industry sales of a particular product or service that is controlled by a company.

words.ex: The library is on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆在二楼。
words.en: The level of a building that is immediately above the ground floor.

words.tr: phrase. 学生顾问 无中文释义
words.ex: The students adviser helps with course choices.
words.ex_cn: 学生顾问帮助选择课程。

words.ex: There are lots of stairs in the old building.
words.ex_cn: 这座老建筑里有很多楼梯。
words.en: A large number of steps used for ascending or descending between different levels of a building or structure.

words.tr: phrase. +n. 稀有的狮子；罕见的狮子
words.ex: Rare lions live in the wild forests.
words.ex_cn: 稀有的狮子生活在野外森林中。
words.en: Lions that are not commonly found; scarce in number.

words.tr:
n. 船；舰；
v. 装运；
words.ex: The ship sailed across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了海洋。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea.

words.tr: phrase. 小组讨论；团体会谈
words.ex: They have group talks every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周五都有小组讨论。
words.en: Conversations or discussions held by a small number of people, often in an informal setting.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.tr: phrase. 播放音乐；演奏音乐
words.ex: He plays music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上演奏音乐。
words.en: To play music means to perform or cause music to be heard, often by using a device such as a radio, stereo, or computer.

words.ex: The students gave presentations about their science projects.
words.ex_cn: 学生们做了关于他们科学项目的报告。
words.en: The act of presenting or the state of being presented.

words.tr: v. 污染；弄脏；“contaminate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The river was contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 河流被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: If something is contaminated, it has been made dirty or harmful, usually by the addition of something, especially chemicals or radiation.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: It is raining outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面正在下雨。
words.en: The process of water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期一有个会议。
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.tr: phrase. 来自互联网的课程；网络课程
words.ex: He takes courses from internet to learn new skills.
words.ex_cn: 他通过网络课程学习新技能。
words.en: Educational classes or lessons delivered via the internet.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.ex: The child was afraid of the dark place under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕床底下的黑暗地方。
words.en: a location with little or no light

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.ex: His objectives are to learn English and find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是学好英语并找到一份好工作。
words.en: An objective is something you plan to achieve, especially in business or politics.

words.tr: phrase. 自己的汽车；私人汽车
words.ex: He has his own car.
words.ex_cn: 他有自己的车。
words.en: A vehicle that is personally owned and not shared or rented.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: Please lock all windows before you leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 离开房子前请锁上所有窗户。
words.en: To secure all windows by fastening them to prevent entry or movement.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上唱歌。
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.tr: n. 植物；发电厂；工厂；作物；“plant”的复数；
words.ex: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要阳光和水来生长。
words.en: Plants are living organisms that typically grow in soil and have leaves, stems, and roots. They are essential for the environment as they produce oxygen and provide food for many animals.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.tr: phrase. 肥沃的土壤；能生育的土壤
words.ex: The farmers planted crops in fertile soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在肥沃的土壤里种植庄稼。
words.en: Soil that is rich in nutrients and ideal for plant growth.

words.ex: She sent out eight invitations for her birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日派对寄出了八份邀请函。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.tr:
n. 问题；疑问；
v. 怀疑；询问；
words.ex: He asked a simple question in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上问了一个简单的问题。
words.en: A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.ex: The store uses video cameras to watch for thieves.
words.ex_cn: 商店使用摄像机来监视小偷。
words.en: Cameras designed to record moving images, commonly used for surveillance, broadcasting, or personal recording.

words.ex: He scans the barcode with a small machine.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小机器扫描条形码。
words.en: A bar code is a pattern of thick and thin black lines that is printed on things you buy. It contains information that a computer can read.

words.tr: phrase. 城市桥梁；连接城市区域的桥梁
words.ex: The city bridge connects two parts of the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市桥梁连接了城镇的两个部分。
words.en: A structure spanning a river or road in a city, connecting two areas.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He wears a leather jacket in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿皮夹克。
words.en: A leather jacket is a jacket-length coat that is usually worn on top of other apparel, and which is made from the tanned hide of various animals. The leather material is typically dyed black, or various shades of brown, but a wide range of colors is possible.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: He gave me his business cards at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上给了我他的名片。
words.en: A small card printed with one's name, professional occupation, company position, business address, etc., used in business.

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地矿物丰富。
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.tr: n. 听力；听觉； v. 听；听见；“hear”的现在分词；
words.ex: His hearing is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的听力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: The ability to perceive sounds; a session in which evidence and arguments are presented to a court or committee.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.tr: phrase. 新口味；新品味；新体验
words.ex: He tried a new taste of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他尝了一种新的冰淇淋口味。
words.en: A new taste refers to a flavor or style that is different from what has been experienced before, often used in the context of food and beverages to describe something novel or innovative.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 研究体系；科研系统；调查研究制度
words.ex: The school uses a new research system to track student progress.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一个新的研究系统来跟踪学生的进步。
words.en: A structured method or framework for conducting scholarly inquiry.

words.ex: The movie showed an unnatural movement of the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了树木不合自然规律的运动。
words.en: If you describe something as unnatural, you mean that it is not normal or not what you usually expect, especially in a way that is unpleasant or worrying.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: They parked the caravan by the lake for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旅行拖车停在湖边过周末。
words.en: A caravan is a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.

words.tr: phrase. 本地艺术家；当地艺人
words.ex: Local artists paint colorful murals on the walls.
words.ex_cn: 本地艺术家在墙上画彩色壁画。
words.en: Local artists refer to artists who are based in or originate from a particular area or community.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.tr: n. 样品陈列室；展销厅；
words.ex: The car showroom has many new models on display.
words.ex_cn: 汽车样品陈列室里有许多新款车型展出。
words.en: A showroom is a large room used for displaying goods, especially cars, furniture, or electrical appliances, for sale.

words.tr: phrase. 教研室；员工休息室
words.ex: The teachers are having a meeting in the staff room.
words.ex_cn: 老师们正在教研室开会。
words.en: A room in a school or college where teachers can work and relax.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: He checked his messages on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了手机上的信息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr: n. 游泳；游泳运动； v. “swim”的现在分词；
words.ex: Swimming is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 游泳对健康有益。
words.en: the sport or activity of moving through water by moving your arms and legs

words.ex: He is chewing gum during class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课时在嚼口香糖。
words.en: Chewing gum is a type of gum made for chewing but not swallowing, often flavored and sometimes used for freshening breath.

words.ex: We went on a night tour of the city.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了城市的夜间游览。
words.en: A guided visit or trip around a place, especially one conducted in the evening or at night, often to see sights that are particularly impressive or beautiful when illuminated.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness room every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身室。
words.en: A room equipped with machines and equipment for physical exercise and fitness training.

words.ex: The traffic flow is slow during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通流量很慢。
words.en: The movement of vehicles or pedestrians along a street or other route.

words.ex: Marine plants grow in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 海洋植物生长在海洋中。
words.en: Marine plants are plants that grow in or near the sea and are adapted to life in saltwater environments. They are an essential part of the marine ecosystem, providing food and habitat for a variety of marine organisms.

words.tr: n. 采矿；采矿业； v. “mine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Mining is an important industry in this region.
words.ex_cn: 采矿是这个地区的重要产业。
words.en: Mining is the process of extracting minerals and other materials from the earth.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: I eat bananas for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早餐吃香蕉。
words.en: If someone is bananas, they are extremely angry or crazy about something.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: His working hours are from 9 to 5.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作时间是早上九点到下午五点。
words.en: The period of time that a person spends at their job on a given day.

words.ex: They wear formal clothes to the office every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天穿正式衣服去办公室。
words.en: To dress in attire that is appropriate for a formal occasion.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: The students go to the computer centre to do their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去计算机中心做作业。
words.en: A computer centre is a facility equipped with computers and related technology for use by students, staff, or the public, typically in an educational institution.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr:
adj. 欧洲的；欧洲人的；欧盟的；
n. 欧洲人；
words.ex: She bought a European car.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆欧洲的汽车。
words.en: European means belonging or relating to Europe, or to its people or culture.

words.tr: phrase. 大学讲座；大学授课
words.ex: The professor gave an inspiring university lecture on environmental science.
words.ex_cn: 教授就环境科学进行了一次鼓舞人心的大学讲座。
words.en: A university lecture is a formal talk given to students at a university, typically as part of a course of study.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.ex: The game uses a simulation of weather changes.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏使用了天气变化的模拟。
words.en: A simulation is an imitation of a situation or process.

words.tr: phrase. 小屋的钥匙；舱室的钥匙
words.ex: He lost the cabin keys before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前弄丢了小木屋的钥匙。
words.en: A set of keys or keychain used to access or lock a cabin, typically for a specific room or building.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.ex: He telephoned the employer to ask about the job.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话给雇主询问工作的事。
words.en: To contact an employer by phone, typically to discuss a job application or interview.

words.tr: phrase. 嗅觉；闻气味的能力
words.ex: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
words.ex_cn: 狗有很强的嗅觉。
words.en: The ability to perceive odors or scents.

words.tr: phrase. 教学方法；教授方式
words.ex: The school uses new teaching methods to help students learn better.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用新的教学方法来帮助学生学得更好。
words.en: Teaching methods refer to the principles and methods used for instruction. They are the strategies and techniques that teachers use to impart knowledge to students.

words.tr: phrase. 项目数量；物品数量；条目数
words.ex: The number of items on the list is five.
words.ex_cn: 清单上的物品数量是五个。
words.en: The count of objects or things being considered.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.tr: phrase. 工作类型；职业种类
words.ex: He wants to know types of jobs in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他想了解这座城市里的各种工作类型。
words.en: Different categories or kinds of employment or work.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.ex: He works a part-time job after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后做一份兼职工作。
words.en: A part-time job is a job in which you work fewer hours each week than people who have a full-time job.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: Human activities cause pollution in the river.
words.ex_cn: 人类活动导致河流污染。
words.en: Human activities refer to the various actions and behaviors undertaken by humans, which can have a wide range of effects on the natural environment and society.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 古老的图书馆；旧图书馆
words.ex: The old library has many dusty books.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧图书馆有很多积满灰尘的书。
words.en: A building that houses books and other materials for reading or study, which is no longer in use or has existed for a long time.

words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭的气味；居家的气息
words.ex: The domestic smells made the house feel warm.
words.ex_cn: 家常的气味让房子感觉温暖。
words.en: The characteristic smells associated with a home or household.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.tr: phrase. 自然学科；自然科学科目
words.ex: He likes natural subjects like biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学和化学等自然科学。
words.en: People or groups that are inherently suitable or predisposed to be studied or observed in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 唱歌； adj. 唱歌的； v. “sing”的现在分词；
words.ex: Singing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 唱歌是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of producing musical sounds with the voice, often in a structured and continuous manner.

words.tr:
adj. 挨家挨户的；送货上门的
adv. 挨家挨户地；送货上门地
words.ex: He does door-to-door sales every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都进行上门推销。
words.en: Going to each house in an area to sell or deliver something, or to collect information.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: The soup is too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了。
words.en: Something that is salty contains salt or tastes of salt.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.tr: phrase. 新小说；新出版的小说
words.ex: He just published a new novel about love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 他刚刚出版了一本关于爱情与失去的新小说。
words.en: A recently published book of fiction.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: The company wrote a clear mission statement.
words.ex_cn: 公司写了一份清晰的使命宣言。
words.en: A mission statement is a short description of the overall purpose and intention of an organization or individual, typically used to guide decision-making and communicate the organization's goals to stakeholders.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: We sat in the non-smoking section at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅的无烟区就座。
words.en: A part of a public area, especially in a restaurant, where smoking is not allowed.

words.ex: He turns on the desk lamp to read at night.
words.ex_cn: 他打开台灯晚上读书。
words.en: A desk lamp is a lamp that is placed on a desk to provide light for reading or working.

words.ex: The teacher showed us slides about the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们展示了关于太阳系的幻灯片。
words.en: Slides can refer to a series of images projected onto a screen or a surface, typically used in presentations, or to a smooth, inclined surface for children to play on by sliding down. As a verb, it means to move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.tr: phrase. 发送新闻通讯；寄送电子报
words.ex: They send newsletter every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周五发送新闻简报。
words.en: To distribute a regularly published report or bulletin, typically via email, to a list of subscribers.

words.tr: phrase. 健康的益处；对健康有好处的好处
words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you a healthy benefit.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能带来健康的益处。
words.en: A healthy benefit refers to the positive effects or advantages that contribute to one's physical or mental well-being.

words.ex: We discussed many topics in class today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我们课堂上讨论了很多话题。
words.en: Subjects or themes that are discussed, written about, or studied.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.tr: n. 直升机（helicopter的复数形式）
words.ex: The helicopters flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: He is doing report writing for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为科学课写报告。
words.en: Report writing is the process of creating a document that presents information in a structured format, often for business, scientific, or technical purposes. It involves researching, organizing, and presenting data and findings in a clear and concise manner.

words.ex: Many people joined the demonstrations for better wages.
words.ex_cn: 许多人参加了为争取更好工资的游行。
words.en: A demonstration is a march or gathering which people take part in to show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: The toy factory makes small cars for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具工厂为孩子们制造小汽车。
words.en: A toy factory is a place where toys are manufactured.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.ex: The baby learned to roll over at three months.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝三个月大时学会了翻身。
words.en: To move by turning over and over on an axis; to defer or transfer something to a later time or another account.

words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆在星期日免费入场。
words.en: The permission or right to enter a place or event without payment.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.ex: We went to three parties last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去了三个派对。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.ex: The room has beautiful decoration and art on the walls.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的墙上有着美丽的装饰与艺术。
words.en: The combination of decoration and art refers to the use of artistic elements to enhance the aesthetic appeal of a space or object.

words.ex: He entered his id code to log in.
words.ex_cn: 他输入了他的身份代码来登录。
words.en: An ID code is a unique sequence of letters or numbers used to identify a person, product, or system.

words.ex: He put on a wet suit before swimming in the cold sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在冰冷的海里游泳前穿上了游泳衣。
words.en: A wetsuit is a close-fitting garment made of rubber and neoprene, worn by divers, windsurfers, and others engaged in water sports, to keep their bodies warm in cold water.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.tr: phrase. 经济史；对历史上经济制度、活动与发展变化的研究
words.ex: He is learning economic history at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习经济史。
words.en: Economic history is a field of study that examines the development of economies over time, including the factors that have influenced their growth and decline.

words.tr: phrase. 试驾；测试驾驶（车辆）
words.ex: He is test driving a new car tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要试驾一辆新车。
words.en: The act of driving a vehicle to assess its performance, comfort, and suitability before purchase.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: He focuses on objective matters in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上专注于客观事项。
words.en: A subject or issue that is factual, unbiased, and relevant to the main point of discussion.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.tr:
n. 眼睛；
v. 注视；审视；
words.ex: He hurt his eye in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中伤了眼睛。
words.en: The organ of sight in humans and animals, typically one of a pair, which is sensitive to light and enables vision.

words.ex: The medicine has some side effects.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有一些副作用。
words.en: Unintended effects of a drug or treatment that occur along with the desired effect.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了夹克。
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr: phrase. 因年久而恶化；因年龄增长而退化
words.ex: The old bridge has deteriorated for age.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥因年久而恶化。
words.en: To become worse or decline in quality due to the effects of growing older.

words.tr: phrase. 学习能力；指个体获取、理解、记忆和应用知识的能力
words.ex: His study ability improved after he changed his habits.
words.ex_cn: 他的学习能力在他改变习惯后提高了。
words.en: The capacity to acquire and apply knowledge through study.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: He reads aloud to his little sister every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为他的小妹妹大声朗读。
words.en: To speak the words that you are reading, so that other people can hear them.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: She heated the food in the microwave.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在微波炉里加热。
words.en: A microwave is a type of oven that cooks or heats food very quickly by using electromagnetic waves rather than heat.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: The robots are cleaning the floor.
words.ex_cn: 机器人正在打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically, especially one programmable by a computer.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: She was born in April.
words.ex_cn: 她出生于四月。
words.en: The fourth month of the year, in the northern hemisphere usually considered the second month of spring.

words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在街上玩耍。
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.tr: phrase. 犯罪小说；以犯罪行为和侦探破案为主题的虚构文学作品
words.ex: She enjoys reading criminal fiction in her free time.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在闲暇时阅读犯罪小说。
words.en: Criminal fiction is a literary genre that fictionalizes crimes, their detection, criminals, and their motives. It is usually distinguished from mainstream fiction and other genres such as historical fiction or science fiction, but the boundaries are indistinct.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.tr:
adj. 人的；人类的；
n. 人；人类；
words.ex: Human emotions are complex and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 人的情感复杂而强大。
words.en: A human is a member of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.ex: They have a double bedroom for guests.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个供客人用的双人卧室。
words.en: A bedroom that is designed to accommodate two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: They elect a new president every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他们每四年选举一位新总统。
words.en: To choose someone for a particular job or position by voting.

words.ex: He picked his dinner from the salad bar.
words.ex_cn: 他从沙拉吧挑选了他的晚餐。
words.en: A salad bar is a buffet-style table or counter at a restaurant or food service facility where customers can assemble their own salad plates from a variety of ingredients.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.ex: He looks at the clock every hour.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时看一次钟。
words.en: A clock is an instrument that shows the time, usually in hours and minutes.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr: n. 生日( birthday的名词复数 )
words.ex: We eat cake on birthdays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在生日时吃蛋糕。
words.en: The anniversary of the day on which a person was born, typically treated as an occasion for celebration and the giving of gifts.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.tr: phrase. 照片统计；照片数据统计
words.ex: He uses photo statistics to count birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他使用照片统计来计算公园里的鸟的数量。
words.en: Statistical data or analysis related to photographs, such as usage, popularity, or metadata.

words.ex: He sent the letter by registered mail.
words.ex_cn: 他通过挂号信寄出了这封信。
words.en: A type of mail service that provides the sender with a receipt and a record of delivery.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr: v. 装饰；装修；“decorate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She decorated the room with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用花装饰了房间。
words.en: If something is decorated, it has had decorations added to it to make it look more attractive.

words.ex: He took passport photos at the photo shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在照相馆拍了护照照片。
words.en: Photographs that are required for official documents such as passports, meeting specific size and quality criteria.

words.tr: n. 依恋；附件；附加装置；
words.ex: The child showed strong attachment to his teddy bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对他的泰迪熊产生了强烈的依恋。
words.en: An attachment is a file that is sent along with an email message.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.tr: phrase. 动作电影；以打斗、追逐、爆炸等激烈场面为主要特征的影片
words.ex: He likes to watch action movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看动作片。
words.en: A film genre that features exciting sequences such as fights, chases, and explosions, often with a fast-paced plot.

words.tr: phrase. 爬树；攀树（指攀爬树木的活动或运动）
words.ex: The children love tree climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在周末爬树。
words.en: The activity of climbing trees, often for recreation or as a form of exercise.

words.ex: The kitchen area is clean and bright.
words.ex_cn: 厨房区域干净又明亮。
words.en: A part of a house or building where food is prepared and cooked, typically containing a stove, sink, and storage space.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.ex: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎著名的地标。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a place that is easily recognized and can be used to judge your position or the position of other buildings or features.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.tr: n. 装饰品；装饰物；“decoration”的复数；
words.ex: The Christmas tree has many colorful decorations.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞树上有许多五彩缤纷的装饰品。
words.en: Objects or materials used to make a place look more attractive, especially something used for a special occasion or celebration.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.tr: phrase. 文章的复印件；文章影印本
words.ex: He made a photocopy of article for the class.
words.ex_cn: 他为班级复印了一篇文章。
words.en: A single copy of an article made using a photocopier.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.tr: phrase. 群体规模；团队人数
words.ex: The group size is five students.
words.ex_cn: 小组人数是五名学生。
words.en: The number of individuals in a group.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: Students must finish their end-of-term research before the exam week.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须在考试周前完成他们的期末研究。

words.ex: He selects the menu on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 他在屏幕上选择菜单。

words.tr: phrase. 紧急出口门；应急门
words.ex: The children ran to the emergency doors during the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾发生时，孩子们跑向紧急出口。
words.en: Emergency doors are doors designated for use as an exit in the event of an emergency, such as a fire.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: He made a video recording of his dog playing.
words.ex_cn: 他录了一段他狗玩耍的视频。
words.en: The process of capturing moving images on film or digitally.

words.ex: He watches a television programme every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一个电视节目。
words.en: A television programme is a segment of content intended for broadcast on television, which can include a variety of genres such as news, drama, comedy, and documentaries.

words.ex: The soldiers stood at the lookout point to watch for enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们站在侦查哨观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A place that provides a wide and clear view of the surrounding area, often used for observation or sightseeing.

words.ex: The children are enjoying face painting at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上享受着面部彩绘。
words.en: The activity or art of painting designs or pictures on someone's face, typically for entertainment or as part of a costume.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.tr:
n. 刺；刺痛；
v. 刺；刺痛；
words.ex: The bee gave him a sharp sting.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给了他一下刺痛。
words.en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, it pricks your skin and usually pushes poison into your body with a sharp pointed part of its body.

words.tr: phrase. 学生报纸；由学生编辑和出版的校园刊物
words.ex: The student newspaper writes about school events.
words.ex_cn: 学生报纸报道学校活动。
words.en: A newspaper produced by students at a school, college, or university, covering topics of interest to the student body.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr:
n. 旗；旗帜；信号旗；
v. 用旗标记；
words.ex: The flag waves in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: A flag is a piece of cloth with a special design or colors that is used as a symbol, or to give a signal.

words.ex: I will go to London next year.
words.ex_cn: 我明年去伦敦。
words.en: The year following the current one.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: He eats lunch in the college dining room.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A college dining room refers to a place within a college or university where students can eat meals. It is typically a large area with tables and chairs, and it may offer a variety of food options.

words.ex: He collects old stamps from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的旧邮票。
words.en: Stamps are small pieces of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it. They show that you have paid to send the letter or package.

words.ex: He uses rock salt to melt ice on the driveway.
words.ex_cn: 他用岩盐融化车道上的冰。
words.en: Rock salt is the mineral form of sodium chloride (NaCl), also known as halite. It is commonly used in de-icing roads and walkways, as well as in food preservation.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.tr: phrase. 急救箱；用于处理轻微伤害或紧急情况的医疗用品包
words.ex: I keep a first aid kit in my car.
words.ex_cn: 我把603急救箱放在车里。
words.en: A first aid kit is a collection of supplies and equipment that is used to give medical treatment.

words.ex: The children saw butterflies in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在花园里看到了蝴蝶。
words.en: Butterflies are insects with large, often brightly coloured wings, which they use to fly.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.tr: n. 艺术家；画家；“artist”的复数；
words.ex: The artists painted beautiful pictures.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家们画了美丽的画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or a hobby.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.tr: phrase. 优质土壤；肥沃的土壤
words.ex: The garden thrived on quality soil, producing abundant vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园得益于优质土壤，生产了丰富的蔬菜。
words.en: Soil that is fertile and suitable for growing healthy plants.

words.ex: Celebrities often appear on TV shows.
words.ex_cn: 名人经常出现在电视节目中。
words.en: Celebrities are famous people, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: The university raised overseas students' tuition this year.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学今年提高了海外学生的学费。

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: These shoes are washable and easy to clean.
words.ex_cn: 这些鞋子可以水洗，容易清洁。
words.en: Shoes that can be washed without being damaged.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the chemist's.
words.ex_cn: 他在药房买了药。
words.en: A chemist's is a shop where medicines and other health-related products are sold, and where prescriptions can be filled.

words.tr:
n. 水果；
v. 结果实；
words.ex: I like fruit.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果。
words.en: The edible part of a plant that develops from a flower, especially one that is sweet and contains seeds.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 深夜里，火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: A device that makes a loud noise to warn people of a fire.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: He went to the club office to pay his fee.
words.ex_cn: 他去俱乐部办公室交费。
words.en: A club office is a place within a club where administrative tasks are conducted.

words.tr: phrase. 论文提纲；文章结构大纲
words.ex: He wrote an essay outline before starting his paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始写论文前写了一个文章提纲。
words.en: A plan or a summary of the main points of an essay, which helps in organizing thoughts and arguments before the actual writing begins.

words.ex: They share room in a dormitory to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他们合住一间宿舍房间以节省开支。
words.en: A room that is occupied by more than one person, typically to reduce costs.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了袜子。
words.en: A piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of wool or cotton.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: The editing of the book took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的编辑花了三个月。
words.en: The process of revising and preparing a written, recorded, or filmed material for publication or presentation.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: The company signed two contracts with new suppliers.
words.ex_cn: 公司与两家新供应商签订了合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties that is enforceable by law. It can also refer to a reduction in size or amount.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.tr: phrase. 动物的移动；动物运动
words.ex: The animal movement is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 动物在冬天的移动很慢。
words.en: The act or process of moving from one place to another by animals.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机故障；电脑系统崩溃
words.ex: The office had many computer breakdowns last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周办公室出现了很多电脑故障。
words.en: n. Failures or malfunctions in computer systems that disrupt normal operations.

words.ex: He watches online tutorials to learn coding.
words.ex_cn: 他观看在线教程来学习编程。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: The help desk gave me a new password.
words.ex_cn: 帮助台给了我一个新密码。
words.en: A help desk is a service provided by a company or organization to give assistance and information, usually for users of its products or services.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正坐在教室里。
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.tr: 对假期做计划，规划假期
words.ex: They plan holidays every summer to visit new places.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都计划假期去参观新的地方。
words.en: Organize or arrange vacations.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: He took a fishing lesson last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期六上了一节钓鱼课。
words.en: A session or course designed to teach the skills and techniques of fishing.

words.ex: He went to the changing room to put on his shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他去更衣室穿鞋。
words.en: A changing room is a room where people can change their clothes, for example before and after sports or at a store.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: phrase. 最便宜的预算；最经济的预算方案
words.ex: This hotel offers the cheapest budget stay in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店提供这座城市最便宜的预算住宿。
words.en: The most inexpensive option within a limited financial plan or cost constraint.

words.ex: The brush is made of horse hair.
words.ex_cn: 这把刷子是用马毛做的。
words.en: Horse hair refers to the hair from the mane or tail of a horse, used for various purposes such as in brushes, upholstery, and musical instruments.

words.tr: phrase. 中心部分；核心部分
words.ex: The central part of the city is busy with people.
words.ex_cn: 城市的中心部分人很多。
words.en: The central or middle section of something, such as a book, a city, or a discussion, often serving as the main focus or core area.

words.tr: phrase. 广播节目；电台节目
words.ex: He listens to a radio program every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听一个广播节目。
words.en: A radio program is a segment of content intended for broadcast on radio. It may be a one-time production or part of a periodically recurring series.

words.tr: phrase. 清洁材料；用于清洁的各种用品，如清洁剂、抹布、刷子等
words.ex: He bought cleaning materials for the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他为厨房买了清洁用品。
words.en: Substances used for cleaning, like detergents, soaps, and disinfectants.

words.tr: phrase. 特价商品；特价销售
words.ex: The store has special offers on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在周末有特价优惠。
