words.en: Special offers are discounts or deals that are available for a limited time to encourage people to buy a product or service.

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；
words.ex: The sky has a blue colour.
words.ex_cn: 天空有一种蓝色。
words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.tr: phrase. 步行俱乐部；徒步社团
words.ex: He joins a walking club every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期天都参加一个步行俱乐部。
words.en: A group or organization that organizes walks for its members, often for exercise, socializing, or exploring.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.tr: 短语. 历史上首次的
words.ex: He was the first in history to win the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他是历史上第一个赢得金牌的人。
words.en: Being the first occurrence of something in history.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr: phrase. 分行经理；部门主管
words.ex: The branch manager helps customers at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 分行经理在银行帮助顾客。
words.en: A branch manager is a person who is in charge of a particular branch of a company or organization, responsible for its overall performance and management.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.ex: My father cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我父亲每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A male parent of a child; a man who has begotten a child.

words.tr: n. 记录；“record”的复数； v. 记录；
words.ex: The school keeps records of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: Records refer to information that has been written down or stored on a computer, or to the process of storing information in this way. It can also refer to a musical recording or the act of making a musical recording.

words.tr: n. 窗户；窗口；电脑窗口；“window”的复数；
words.ex: The children are looking out of the windows.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正从窗户往外看。
words.en: Windows is an operating system developed by Microsoft, which allows users to manage files and run applications on their computers.

words.tr: phrase. 窗口的风景；窗口视图
words.ex: I like the window view of the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢窗户看到的山景。
words.en: The scene or vista visible through an opening in a wall, typically a window.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中的休息时间；茶歇
words.ex: We took a coffee break at 10 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午10点休息喝咖啡。
words.en: A short period of rest from work during which people drink coffee or other beverages.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: He adds antifreeze to the car in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天给汽车加防冻液。
words.en: A substance added to a liquid to lower its freezing point, used especially in the radiator of a motor vehicle.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: The fish swim among the seaweed near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海藻间游动。
words.en: Seaweed is a plant that grows in the sea, especially in the ocean. It is often used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天戴一顶黑帽子。
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: He is traveling for business next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周因公出差。

words.ex: He hurt his jaw when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了下巴。
words.en: The jaw is the part of your face below your mouth that moves when you eat or speak.

words.ex: I drink coffee every mornings.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早晨喝咖啡。
words.en: The early part of the day, from sunrise to noon.

words.ex: He enjoys horse riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for pleasure or sport.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The hotel offers free wifi for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供免费无线网络。
words.en: A technology that allows electronic devices to connect to a wireless local area network (WLAN).

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: He works at a call centre in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦的一家呼叫中心工作。
words.en: A call centre is an office where people work answering or making telephone calls for a particular company.

words.ex: The ancient stone has an inscription in Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这块古老的石头上有一段拉丁文碑文。
words.en: An inscription is a piece of writing or a short message that is written or carved on something, especially as a formal or permanent record.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: The painters created beautiful murals on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 画家们在墙上创作了美丽的壁画。
words.en: Individuals who create paintings as their profession.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.tr: phrase. 工业材料；用于制造、建筑或生产的原材料或半成品
words.ex: The factory uses industrial material to make machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用工业材料来制造机器。
words.en: A substance used in manufacturing or industrial processes.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的兄弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟；姻兄弟
words.ex: My brother-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐夫/妹夫在医院工作。
words.en: The brother of your husband or wife, or the man who is married to your sister.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞过树。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.ex: The students bought new textbooks for the semester.
words.ex_cn: 学生们为这学期买了新课本。
words.en: Textbooks are books used in the study of a subject, containing facts and ideas about that subject.

words.tr: n. 标签；“label”的复数； v. 贴标签；
words.ex: The bottles have clear labels.
words.ex_cn: 这些瓶子上有清晰的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, plastic, or other material which is attached to an object and gives information about it.

words.ex: She washed the bed sheet yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天洗了床单。
words.en: A bed sheet is a large piece of cloth used to cover a mattress, often used in pairs with one sheet below the sleeper and one sheet above.

words.ex: The rabbits hide behind the bushes.
words.ex_cn: 兔子藏在灌木后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant that grows to a medium height and has many branches.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.ex: He majored in forestry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修森林学。
words.en: The science or practice of planting, managing, and caring for forests.

words.ex: The museum displays old sandglasses from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自古代的沙漏。
words.en: A sandglass is a device for measuring time, consisting of two glass bulbs connected by a narrow passage through which sand flows from the upper to the lower bulb.

words.ex: He bought a new car last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一辆新车。
words.en: A recently manufactured automobile, typically one that has not been previously owned.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 道路系统；路网；公路体系
words.ex: The city improved its road system last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改善了它的道路系统。
words.en: A road system refers to the network of roads within a particular area, including highways, streets, and other routes that allow for the movement of vehicles and pedestrians.

words.tr: n. 回收利用； v. 再循环；“recycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Recycling helps reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 回收利用有助于减少浪费。
words.en: The process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects.

words.ex: They meet at the clubhouse every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六在会所见面。
words.en: A clubhouse is a building used by members of a particular club, especially a sports club, for socializing, changing clothes, etc.

words.ex: He visits many places during his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行期间去了很多地方。
words.en: Places refer to specific areas or locations, which can be physical locations or positions within a sequence or order.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.ex: He made many drawings of birds.
words.ex_cn: 他画了很多鸟的素描。
words.en: Drawings are pictures that are made with a pen, pencil, or crayon rather than paint, or the art of making such pictures.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: The children played on the green hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在绿色的丘陵上玩耍。
words.en: A hill is a piece of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it, but not as high as a mountain.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: He paid with a cheque yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天用支票付款了。
words.en: A written order to a bank to pay a specified sum from someone's account.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: He went to summer school to learn math.
words.ex_cn: 他去暑期学校学数学。
words.en: Summer school is an educational institution or program offering courses during the summer vacation, especially for students who need to catch up or wish to get ahead in their studies.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: The alarming system woke us up during the fire.
words.ex_cn: 报警系统在火灾时把我们叫醒了。
words.en: An alarming system is a set of devices designed to alert individuals to specific dangers, such as fire, intrusion, or other emergencies, through audible and/or visible means.

words.ex: He goes to the health club every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都去健身俱乐部。
words.en: A health club is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical fitness.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: He picked up the receiver to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起听筒接电话。
words.en: A receiver is a person who receives something or a device that receives signals and converts them into sound or pictures.

words.ex: He always wears his seat belt when driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车时总是系安全带。
words.en: A seat belt is a strap that you fasten across your body when travelling in a car or aeroplane to prevent you from being thrown forward if there is a sudden stop or accident.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He saves money for long term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Relating to or extending over a long period of time.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.tr: phrase. 本地学校；当地学校
words.ex: He walks to the local school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去附近的学校。
words.en: An educational institution in the immediate community or area.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙涂成蓝色。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.tr: n. 穿衣； v. “dress”的现在分词；
words.ex: Every morning, she makes a quick dressing before leaving home.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，她出门前都会快速穿衣。
words.en: A dressing is a sauce, especially one consisting of oil and vinegar mixed together with herbs or other flavorings, which you put on salad or other foods.

words.tr: phrase. 已知世界；人类已探索或了解的地区
words.ex: Explorers sailed to the edges of the known world.
words.ex_cn: 探险家们航行到了已知世界的边缘。
words.en: The part of the world that is familiar or recognized by a person or group.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.tr: phrase. 绿色的箭头（常用于交通标志或指示方向）
words.ex: The green arrows point to the right.
words.ex_cn: 绿色的箭头指向右边。
words.en: Arrows colored green, often indicating direction or permission.

words.tr: phrase. 邮寄调查；通过邮政方式发放的问卷调研
words.ex: They sent a postal survey to every household.
words.ex_cn: 他们给每户家庭寄了一份邮寄调查问卷。
words.en: A method of collecting data by sending questionnaires through the mail to a sample of individuals or households.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: She lit the candles for a cozy dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她点燃了蜡烛，营造温馨的晚餐氛围。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a string through the middle which you burn to give light.

words.tr: n. 期望；估计；所希望的东西；“expectation”的复数；
words.ex: His parents had high expectations for his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他的父母对他的成绩有很高的期望。
words.en: Your beliefs about what will happen in the future, especially about whether something good or bad will happen.

words.ex: He walks to the city centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去市中心。
words.en: The central part of a city, where there are often many shops, businesses, and cultural attractions.

words.ex: He hurt the big toe on his right foot.
words.ex_cn: 他伤到了右脚的大脚趾。
words.en: The largest toe on the human foot, used for balance and propulsion during walking or running.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.tr: phrase. 通信技术；用于传递信息的技术，如电话、互联网、广播等
words.ex: He uses communication technology to talk with his friends far away.
words.ex_cn: 他使用通信技术与远方的朋友交谈。
words.en: Communication technology refers to the tools and systems that enable the transmission of information over distances for the purpose of communication.

words.tr: phrase. 稀有玻璃；珍奇玻璃制品
words.ex: He found a rare glass at the antique market.
words.ex_cn: 他在古董市场发现了一块稀有的玻璃。
words.en: A type of glass that is uncommon and often valuable due to its unique properties or historical significance.

words.ex: He is a swimming coach at the local pool.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地游泳池的游泳教练。
words.en: A swimming coach is a person who trains and instructs swimmers, focusing on improving their technique, speed, and endurance in the water.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: He reads magazines about sports every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读关于体育的杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr: phrase. 细胞研究；对细胞结构、功能及其在生物体中作用的科学研究
words.ex: Cellular research has advanced our understanding of diseases and their treatments.
words.ex_cn: 细胞研究提高了我们对疾病及其治疗的理解。
words.en: Cellular research refers to the study of cells, their structure, function, and their role in organisms. It is a fundamental area of biology that contributes to our understanding of life processes and the development of medical treatments.

words.ex: He shows strong mental ability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很强的思维能力。
words.en: The capacity of an individual to perform the higher mental processes of reasoning, remembering, understanding, and problem solving.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.ex: The government election will happen next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: A government election is a formal decision-making process by which a population chooses an individual or multiple individuals to hold public office.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.tr: phrase. 滑冰；溜冰（指在冰面上穿着冰鞋滑行的运动或活动）
words.ex: He loves ice skating in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天滑冰。
words.en: the activity or sport of moving on ice using ice skates

words.ex: He put the papers together with paperclips.
words.ex_cn: 他用回形针把纸张订在一起。
words.en: Small pieces of bent wire or plastic used for holding sheets of paper together.

words.ex: He likes online shopping for clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在网上买衣服。
words.en: The activity of buying goods or services over the internet.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: We visited a national park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个国家公园。
words.en: A national park is an area of land that is protected by the government because of its natural beauty, plants, or animals, and is open to the public for enjoyment and education.

words.tr: adj. 厚的；浓的；稠密的；浓的( thick的比较级 )；
words.ex: This book is thicker than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书比那本厚。
words.en: Having a greater density or consistency; more substantial.

words.ex: We use different research methods in our study.
words.ex_cn: 我们在研究中使用了不同的研究方法。
words.en: Research methods refer to the techniques and procedures used to conduct research. They include the ways in which data is collected, analyzed, and interpreted to answer research questions or test hypotheses.

words.ex: I go to the library on Wednesdays.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三去图书馆。
words.en: On every Wednesday.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.tr:
adj. 最坏的；最糟糕的；
n. 最坏的事；
words.ex: This is the worst day of my life.
words.ex_cn: 这是我生命中最糟糕的一天。
words.en: Superlative of bad: of the lowest quality, or the most unpleasant, difficult, or severe

words.ex: He gave me his phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我他的电话号码。
words.en: A phone number is a sequence of digits assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks.

words.tr: phrase. 关掉；不再想…；不考虑
words.ex: Please switch off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 你离开前请关掉灯。
words.en: To turn off an electrical device by using a switch.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: We watch movies in the media room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在多媒体室看电影。
words.en: A room designed for entertainment purposes, equipped with audio and video equipment.

words.ex: He wears gloves to keep his hands warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴手套来保暖双手。
words.en: Gloves are pieces of clothing which cover your hands and wrists and have individual sections for each finger. You wear gloves to keep your hands warm or dry or to protect them.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.tr: phrase. 目标清单；目的列表；任务目标一览
words.ex: He wrote a list of objectives for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目写了一份目标清单。
words.en: A set of goals or aims that outline what is to be achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 群体关系；团体之间的相互联系或互动
words.ex: The group relationship helped everyone work together.
words.ex_cn: 这个群体关系帮助大家共同合作。
words.en: A group relationship refers to the connections or interactions between members of a group, which can affect the dynamics and outcomes of the group's activities.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: He lives in Brisbane with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在布里斯班。
words.en: Brisbane is the capital of Queensland, Australia, known for its vibrant arts scene, nightlife, and outdoor activities.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: The conference covered a wide ranging set of topics.
words.ex_cn: 会议涵盖了一系列广泛的主题。
words.en: Covering a large number of different subjects or areas.

words.tr: phrase. 北极星；指引方向的事物；指路明灯
words.ex: The sailor used the northern star to find his way.
words.ex_cn: 水手用北极星来找到方向。
words.en: The Northern Star refers to Polaris, the brightest star in the constellation Ursa Minor, which is located nearly at the north celestial pole and thus appears almost stationary in the night sky.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: Every citizen has the vote right to choose their leader.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都有投票权来选择他们的领导人。
words.en: The right to vote in political elections.

words.ex: His humour makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让每个人都笑起来。
words.en: Humour is the quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.ex: He practices essay writing every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习写作文。
words.en: The activity or skill of writing essays, especially as part of a student's academic work.

words.tr: phrase. 健康问题；身体或心理上的疾病或不适
words.ex: He has health problems because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而有健康问题。
words.en: Issues or conditions that affect the physical or mental well-being of an individual.

words.ex: She walks in the rose garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都在玫瑰园里散步。
words.en: A garden where roses are cultivated.

words.ex: The country is facing an economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临经济危机。
words.en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

words.tr: n. 学者；[复数]（院校的）学术活动；学者( academic的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The academics published a new research paper.
words.ex_cn: 这些学者发表了一篇新的研究论文。
words.en: Academics refers to the scholarly activities of a school or educational institution, especially the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.tr:
adj. 无装备的；无家具设备的
v. 搬走家具；“unfurnish”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The apartment is unfurnished.
words.ex_cn: 这个公寓没有家具。
words.en: If a room or house is unfurnished, it does not contain any furniture.

words.ex: He designs graphics for video games.
words.ex_cn: 他为电子游戏设计绘图。
words.en: Graphics are visual images or designs on some surface, such as a wall, canvas, screen, paper, or stone, to inform, illustrate, or entertain.

words.ex: He wears long trousers to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿长裤上班。
words.en: Trousers that extend to the ankles, as opposed to shorts.

words.ex: The train runs on a long railway line.
words.ex_cn: 火车行驶在一条长长的铁路线上。
words.en: A railway line is the track along which trains run, connecting different places.

words.tr:
adj. 干的；
v. 变干；
words.ex: The cloth is dry after the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在阳光下晒干了。
words.en: If something is dry, there is no water or moisture on it or in it.

words.ex: The origins of this tradition are very old.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源非常久远。
words.en: The origins of something are the causes or reasons that explain why it began to exist.

words.ex: The rivers flow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入大海。
words.en: Rivers are large natural streams of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: Many cities have busy streets and tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市都有繁忙的街道和高楼。
words.en: A city is a large town.

words.ex: He uses written language to send messages.
words.ex_cn: 他用书面语言来发送信息。
words.en: A written language is the representation of a language by means of a writing system. Written languages are an important aspect of human communication, allowing for the recording and transmission of information across time and space.

words.tr: phrase. 中国的面貌；中国人的面孔；中国社会的多元面孔
words.ex: The book shows the faces of China.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了中国人的面孔。
words.en: A title for a collection of images, portraits, or cultural representations showcasing the people, landscapes, or heritage of China.

words.ex: He mends his fishing net by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边修补他的渔网。
words.en: A fishing net is a net used for catching fish in the water.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: Follow the guidelines to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 遵循指南以通过考试。
words.en: Guidelines are general rules, principles, or pieces of advice that help you to do something or to decide what to do in a particular situation.

words.ex: The farmer fertilise the soil before planting.
words.ex_cn: 农民在种植前给土壤施肥。
words.en: To fertilise means to make soil or land more fertile or productive by adding substances to it, or to cause an egg or female animal to become pregnant by introducing male reproductive material.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.tr:
v. 烹饪；
n. 厨师；
words.ex: My mom cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做饭。
words.en: To prepare food for eating by using heat.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: She dried her hands with clean towels.
words.ex_cn: 她用干净的毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick absorbent cloth or paper used for drying oneself or wiping things dry.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: He learns modern language at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习现代语言。
words.en: A modern language is a language that is currently in use in a country or region, as opposed to ancient languages which are no longer spoken.

words.tr: phrase. 管理时间；合理安排时间；掌控时间
words.ex: He must manage the time to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须合理安排时间来完成作业。
words.en: Organize and control how one spends their time to be efficient and productive.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.tr: phrase. 保险公司；承保各类风险并收取保费的企业机构
words.ex: Insurance companies pay money when you have an accident.
words.ex_cn: 当你发生事故时，保险公司会支付钱。
words.en: Insurance companies are businesses that provide insurance policies to individuals or other businesses, covering risks such as accidents, illness, or property damage in exchange for premiums.

words.tr: phrase. 修理包；维修工具包；修补用具套装
words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bicycle.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的自行车买了一个维修工具包。
words.en: A set of tools and materials used for repairing something, especially carried in a vehicle for use in emergencies.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他是父母的好儿子。
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.ex: He wrote three short essays about his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于他旅行的短随笔。
words.en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, often expressing personal views.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.tr: phrase. 蓝卡（通常指某种身份、许可或保险卡，如欧盟的蓝卡工作许可）
words.ex: He got a blue card to work in Germany.
words.ex_cn: 他拿到了一张蓝卡，可以在德国工作。
words.en: A blue card is used in some sports, especially football (soccer), to indicate a temporary suspension of a player for a minor infraction.

words.ex: The subcommittee met to discuss the budget.
words.ex_cn: 小组委员会开会讨论预算。
words.en: A subcommittee is a smaller committee formed from a main committee to concentrate on a specific task or area.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.tr:
n. 风味；味道；
v. 给…添风味；
words.ex: This ice cream has a sweet flavour.
words.ex_cn: 这种冰淇淋有甜美的风味。
words.en: Flavour is the taste of a food or drink, especially when it is pleasant and distinctive.

words.ex: The price tag shows an inclusive tax of $110.
words.ex_cn: 价签上显示的是含税价格110美元。

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: He cooks with olive oil every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都用橄榄油做饭。
words.en: Olive oil is a liquid fat obtained from olives, a traditional tree crop of the Mediterranean Basin. It is commonly used in cooking, for frying foods or as a salad dressing.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的视力；视觉敏锐
words.ex: He has good eyesight and can read small letters.
words.ex_cn: 他视力很好，能看清小字。
words.en: The ability to see well, without the need for glasses or contact lenses.

words.ex: The organisation helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organisation is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.ex: Children like to eat snacks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在放学后吃零食。
words.en: Snacks are small amounts of food that are eaten between meals.

words.ex: He put three spoons of sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他在茶里放了三勺糖。
words.en: A spoon is an implement consisting of a small, shallow oval or round bowl on a long handle, used for eating, stirring, and serving food.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐的；逐步的；渐进的；
words.ex: The change was gradual.
words.ex_cn: 这种变化是逐渐的。
words.en: A gradual change or process happens in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾焚烧厂；废物焚化设施
words.ex: The city built new incineration plants to reduce trash.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市新建了焚烧厂以减少垃圾。
words.en: Facilities where waste is burned at high temperatures to reduce its volume and sometimes generate energy.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 用现金；以现金方式
words.ex: He paid by cash.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金支付。
words.en: Using cash as a method of payment.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: Rabbit meat is eaten in some countries.
words.ex_cn: 在一些国家，人们吃兔肉。
words.en: Meat from a rabbit, often used in stews or roasted.

words.ex: The children play soccer on the sports field.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在运动场上踢足球。
words.en: A sports field is a large outdoor area where sports are played, especially at a school or college.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr:
adj. 灰色的；
n. 灰色；
words.ex: The sky is grey today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是灰色的。
words.en: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.

words.tr: phrase. 鱼饼（一种用鱼肉和调料制成的油炸或煎制食品）
words.ex: He ate fish cakes for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了鱼饼。
words.en: Fish cakes are a type of food made from fish that has been mixed with other ingredients, shaped into a patty, and then fried or baked.

words.tr: phrase. 支票簿（用于签发支票的本子）
words.ex: He lost his cheque book last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周丢了支票簿。
words.en: A cheque book is a book of cheques provided by a bank to its customers, allowing them to make payments by writing cheques.

words.ex: The driver stopped at a rest area to take a break.
words.ex_cn: 司机在休息区停下来休息。
words.en: A rest area is a place beside a major road where people can stop to rest, eat, or use the toilet.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: He wore a dark coloured shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件深色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Having a dark color or shade.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: n. 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科舞厅；
words.ex: We went to a disco last Saturday night.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六晚上去了迪斯科舞会。
words.en: A disco is a club or party where people dance to pop music.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的水；充足的水
words.ex: Make sure to drink plenty of water during the summer to stay hydrated.
words.ex_cn: 夏天一定要多喝水以保持水分。
words.en: A large amount of water; more than enough water.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.tr: phrase. 动物语言；动物之间用于交流的声音、动作或信号系统
words.ex: Scientists study animal language to understand how animals communicate.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究动物语言，以了解动物如何交流。
words.en: Animal language refers to the various forms of communication used by animals, including vocalizations, body language, and chemical signals, to convey information to one another.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: The deer live in the woodland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鹿住在河边的林地中。
words.en: An area of land covered with trees, larger than a wood.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个橙子。
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.ex: We went on many outings in the mountains last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，我们去山上进行了许多远足。
words.en: Outings refer to short trips or excursions, especially those taken for pleasure or education.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在野外大声吼叫。
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: He runs a small scale bakery at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家经营一家小型面包店。
words.en: Small scale refers to something that is limited in size or extent.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.ex: He took a placement test to join the advanced class.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次分班测试，以便进入高级班。
words.en: A placement test is a test usually given to a student entering an educational institution to determine the level of knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject or subjects.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: She is a well-organised student who always finishes her homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient or effective way.

words.ex: We use solar panels to get alternative energy.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用太阳能板来获取可再生能源。
words.en: Alternative energy refers to energy sources that are different from the traditional fossil fuels (coal, oil, and natural gas) and are considered to be more environmentally friendly and sustainable.

words.tr: phrase. 消化问题；消化系统不适
words.ex: He has a digestive problem after eating spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完辣食后有了消化问题。
words.en: A digestive problem refers to any issue that affects the digestion of food, leading to discomfort or illness.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: He adds sweetener to his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他往咖啡里加甜味剂。
words.en: A sweetener is a substance used to sweeten food or drink, especially one that does not contain sugar.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: He pressed the green button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下了绿色按钮来启动机器。
words.en: A green button is a button that is green in color, often used in machines or devices to start or initiate a function.

words.ex: I will visit my grandma next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周去看望我的奶奶。
words.en: The week following the current one.

words.ex: He has muscle pain after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后肌肉酸痛。
words.en: Pain in the muscles, often due to strain or injury.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: He loves snow boarding in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里玩单板滑雪。
words.en: A winter sport involving descending a slope on a snowboard with feet secured to the board.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件红色T恤。
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 会议指南；会议资料册
words.ex: He received a conference pack with notes and a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一份包含笔记和一支笔的会议资料包。
words.en: A set of materials provided to attendees of a conference, typically including the agenda, speaker information, and other relevant documents.

words.ex: The principal gave us a classroom tour.
words.ex_cn: 校长带我们参观了教室。
words.en: A guided walk-through of a classroom, showing its layout, resources, and features.

words.ex: He got his driving license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving license is an official document which shows that you have passed the necessary tests and are allowed to drive a vehicle.

words.tr: phrase. 睡眠问题；指影响正常入睡、睡眠维持或睡眠质量的各种障碍或困扰
words.ex: He has sleeping problems because he stays up late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为熬夜而有睡眠问题。
words.en: Sleeping problems refer to difficulties in falling or staying asleep, or experiencing restful sleep, often leading to significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning.

words.ex: The drug has a negative effect on his health.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对他的健康有负面影响。
words.en: A negative effect is an adverse or unfavorable outcome or impact that results from a particular action, event, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 进餐时间；用餐时段
words.ex: We eat at meal times every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天在用餐时间吃饭。
words.en: The times at which meals are eaten.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.tr: n. 打印机；印刷厂；“printer”的复数；
words.ex: The office bought three new printers.
words.ex_cn: 办公室买了三台新打印机。
words.en: A printer is a machine that prints text or pictures onto paper, especially one linked to a computer.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；家族；
adj. 家庭的；家族的；
words.ex: He belongs to the 587 family.
words.ex_cn: 他属于587家族。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.ex: He is the class representative for Grade 8.
words.ex_cn: 他是八年级的班级代表。
words.en: A class representative is a student elected by their classmates to represent their interests and communicate with teachers and school administration.

words.tr: phrase. 公园广场（指位于公园或紧邻公园的广场空间）
words.ex: They walk to park square every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上走到公园广场。
words.en: A park square is a public open area in a city or town, often surrounded by buildings and featuring greenery, paths, and sometimes monuments or fountains.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: To move or force water or other liquids by means of a pump.

words.tr: n. 均匀厚度的片状硬物体；盘子；碟子；“plate”的复数；
words.ex: The metal plates are used to build the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这些金属片用于建造桥梁。
words.en: Plates are flat, usually round dishes that are used to hold food. They can also refer to thin, flat pieces of metal or other material.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.tr: n. 实习工作；安置( placement的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The university helps students find placements in local companies.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学帮助学生在本地公司找到实习工作。
words.en: The act of placing or arranging someone or something in a particular position or job.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr:
n. 笑话；玩笑；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: He told a funny joke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上讲了一个有趣的笑话。
words.en: A joke is something that is said or done to make people laugh, especially a funny story or a trick played on someone.

words.ex: He talks about his family relationship with his sister every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都会谈论他和妹妹的亲属关系。
words.en: The connection or association between members of a family.

words.tr: phrase. 盲盒拼图无中文释义
words.ex: He opened a blind puzzle box and found a rare toy inside.
words.ex_cn: 他打开一个盲盒，里面发现了一个稀有玩具。

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.tr:
n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
v. 辛勤工作；
words.ex: Hard labour helps people build strong skills.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动帮助人们培养强大的技能。
words.en: Labour is very hard work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group, or the process of childbirth.

words.tr: phrase. 瑜伽课程；指教授瑜伽练习的系列课堂
words.ex: She attends yoga classes every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周一参加瑜伽课。
words.en: Yoga classes are sessions where individuals practice yoga, a physical, mental, and spiritual practice that originated in ancient India, under the guidance of an instructor.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: His heart rate increased after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后心率加快了。
words.en: The number of times the heart beats per minute.

words.ex: The birds nest on the high cliffs.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在高高的悬崖上筑巢。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of land with a very steep side, especially one next to the sea.

words.ex: He wears suits to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上班都穿西装。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually including a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be acceptable or right for someone or something.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: He drives a racing car on the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在赛道上开一辆赛车。
words.en: A racing car is a car designed for speed and performance in competitive racing events.

words.ex: He keeps spare socks in his drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把备用袜子放在抽屉里。
words.en: Spare socks are extra socks that you keep with you in case you need to change your socks.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.tr: adj. 组合的；结合的； v. 组合；结合；“combine”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The combined effort of both teams won the game.
words.ex_cn: 两个团队的联合努力赢得了比赛。
words.en: Made by joining two or more things or people together.

words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.tr: n. 普雷斯科特（人名，常见于英文名字）
words.ex: Prescott is a small town in Arizona.
words.ex_cn: 普雷斯科特是亚利桑那州的一个小镇。
words.en: A surname, commonly associated with historical figures or places, such as the city in Arizona.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的位置；优越的地理位置
words.ex: The hotel has a good location near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的位置很好，靠近火车站。
words.en: A place or position that is advantageous or favorable.

words.ex: She carries a red handbag to work.
words.ex_cn: 她带着一个红色的手提包去上班。
words.en: A handbag is a small bag used by women to carry personal items.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: Children learn through social interactions with their peers.
words.ex_cn: 儿童通过与同龄人的社交互动来学习。
words.en: Social interactions refer to the ways in which people act and react in relation to others.

words.tr: phrase. 警觉的父母；时刻保持警惕的父母
words.ex: Watchful parents check their children's homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 细心的父母每天晚上都会检查孩子的作业。
words.en: Parents who are alert and attentive to their children's needs and safety.

words.ex: He drinks bottled water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝瓶装水。
words.en: Water that has been purified and sealed in bottles for drinking.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.tr: n. 导师；家庭教师；“tutor”的复数；
words.ex: The students meet their tutors every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都见他们的导师。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one student or a very small group of students. As a verb, to tutor means to teach someone privately.

words.tr: phrase. 图片农场；指通过大量上传或采集图片以获取流量、广告收益或提升搜索引擎排名的行为
words.ex: He is picture farming in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他正在乡村进行图片农耕。
words.en: Picture farming refers to the practice of using images or photographs to display or manage agricultural activities.

words.ex: He made a wooden sculpture for the art show.
words.ex_cn: 他为艺术展做了一个木雕。
words.en: A wooden sculpture is a piece of art created by carving wood.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: He shows examples of good writing.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了优秀写作的例子。
words.en: Instances or samples that illustrate a point, demonstrate a concept, or serve as models.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: The flowers bloom from march to may.
words.ex_cn: 花朵从三月到五月盛开。

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr: adj. 现存的； v. 存在；“exist”的现在分词；
words.ex: The existing rules need to be changed.
words.ex_cn: 现有的规则需要更改。
words.en: Existing is used to describe something that is present or available now.

words.ex: The city has many factories that make cars.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多制造汽车的工厂。
words.en: Factories are buildings or groups of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled chiefly by machine.

words.tr: phrase. 可接受的替代方案
words.ex: We need acceptable alternatives to plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可接受的塑料袋替代品。

words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.ex: The company offers express training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供快速培训。

words.ex: Can you summarise the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarise something, you give a summary of it.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.tr: phrase. 繁文缛节；官僚作风；繁琐的官方程序
words.ex: The project was delayed by red tape.
words.ex_cn: 该项目因官僚主义的繁文缛节而延迟。
words.en: Red tape refers to excessive regulation or rigid conformity to formal rules that is considered redundant or bureaucratic and hinders or prevents action or decision-making.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.ex: He works in information technology at a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司从事信息技术工作。
words.en: Information technology refers to the use of computers, storage, networking and other physical devices, infrastructure and processes to create, process, store, secure and exchange all forms of electronic data.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.ex: We visited the American Museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了美国博物馆。
words.en: An institution dedicated to preserving and exhibiting artifacts, artworks, or historical items related to the United States.

words.ex: He shows self-motivation by studying every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天学习展现自我激励。
words.en: Self-motivation refers to the ability to motivate oneself to take initiative and action to pursue goals and complete tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 信息产业；信息部门
words.ex: The government supports information sectors with new technology.
words.ex_cn: 政府用新技术支持信息产业。
words.en: Sectors of the economy that primarily produce, process, and disseminate information, such as telecommunications, software, and media.

words.ex: He plays soccer as his favorite sport.
words.ex_cn: 他把足球当作最喜欢的体育运动。
words.en: Sport is a physical activity that is governed by a set of rules or customs and often engaged in competitively.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；大型零售商店，内部分为多个商品部门
words.ex: She buys clothes at department stores.
words.ex_cn: 她去百货商店买衣服。
words.en: A department store is a large shop which is divided into several departments, each selling a different type of goods.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: The children are of different ages.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子的年龄不同。
words.en: Ages refers to a very long time or the period of history that is being referred to.

words.ex: He is learning vocational skills to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业技能以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Relating to the skills you need to do a particular job.

words.ex: Farmers grow corn as a crop.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植玉米作为农作物。
words.en: A crop is a plant such as wheat, potatoes, or cotton that is grown in large quantities by farmers.

words.ex: They sat at a long table for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在一张长桌旁吃晚饭。
words.en: A table that is longer than the standard size, often used for seating many people or for specific purposes like banquets or conferences.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: Children ride their bikes on the bike track.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自行车道上骑车。

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He drove the pegs into the ground to hold the tent.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉桩钉进地面以固定帐篷。
words.en: Pegs are small devices, usually made of wood or metal, used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.tr: n. 结果；成绩；比分；计算的结果；“result”的复数； v. 起因；导致；
words.ex: The results of the test were good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: Results are the outcomes or consequences of actions, events, or processes.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: The phone has a small microchip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机里面有一个小芯片。
words.en: A microchip is a very small piece of silicon inside a computer. It has electronic circuits on it and can hold large amounts of information or perform mathematical and logical operations.

words.ex: He solved the problem rationally.
words.ex_cn: 他理性地解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a logical and reasonable manner, based on facts or reason rather than emotions or feelings.

words.ex: I took a taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi is a car driven by someone whose job is to take people where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎完成了作业。
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: The doctor used antiseptic cream on the cut.
words.ex_cn: 医生在伤口上用了防腐药膏。
words.en: An antiseptic is a substance that prevents the growth of disease-causing microorganisms.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He plays table tennis every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午打乒乓球。
words.en: Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.
